Peter, __If someone offered you a job you believed in, would you do it for a salary of $1 per year?__ For me, that’s not a hypothetical. _**[I stepped away from my successful business to serve as Indiana’s Secretary of Commerce for just $1 a year, and it was one of the best decisions of my life.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c91ae4062b5a438fb2054125fe3bc571&_e=0OLbQAkDz4uT9gOmOeyqFdB6gHDkNrVqcUwHJ6Jf5UB_5fYYcMHeO95m4TG2JZUA02ZEWzHHFVKGFq25_1HbbIBqx2_ZgDJSS5Jeu-pwIH1bAkoB80TeZHN87j8tRT_5h2QgCBcFBSfWucgYBkERHDPjGNeVV1HSppnDfib6Rzd348kS3sE9VHqJp6T2rBSgQaacdK0yOO2VSwAhT0E5TMjp_BrX5hZAllp6NbgrYWk8ZgGO2eqCXp6jpfYAyemFwY5u68cLHqTAAGsFyztTYZ-GcH11FYTHtQFFTBNYl-V2Yjsiy7_kMm5wpv4wt9GrL7HGIYc_GmSvMsIQWFPXR6lY5PZOyImzD6rItazDPzQ%3D)**_ **Peter, I believe in Indiana. And I always believed in giving back to the state that has allowed me to live my American dream.****Now I want to keep giving back to our great state as our next governor. **
---
| | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c91ae4062b5a438fb2054125fe3bc571&_e=0OLbQAkDz4uT9gOmOeyqFdB6gHDkNrVqcUwHJ6Jf5UB_5fYYcMHeO95m4TG2JZUA02ZEWzHHFVKGFq25_1HbbIBqx2_ZgDJSS5Jeu-pwIH1bAkoB80TeZHN87j8tRT_5h2QgCBcFBSfWucgYBkERHDPjGNeVV1HSppnDfib6Rzd348kS3sE9VHqJp6T2rBSgQaacdK0yOO2VSwAhT0E5TDS5Gzf41PNN3pA3Wv1dJF3ksAtcnGXtzeITR4PiMF2ViWw3JVLHlzpb5DF1hHUNdZP8vMKy-FRbnCKk8-NluX3qgXvcFDuPxJNK7JIMREWnpi2jJKT4DrrjqCxzaaPiErkG6-VCjU1_GuU9Q_5MGKU%3D)

| | As Secretary of Commerce, I saw how an energetic outsider could impact our state. Too many career politicians don’t know the pressure or urgency to deliver results... so they never do! That’s not me, Peter. I built my business from a single rental property to a real estate portfolio exceeding $3 billion and providing careers for 400 employees. I took that same work ethic to the Department of Commerce. My team and I brought in new future-focused industries, invested in Indiana’s entrepreneurs, and oversaw major investments in quality-of-life projects across the state. Just look at these numbers:
* We secured nearly **$51 billion** of committed capital investments in Indiana.
* And average **wages were 30% higher** than ever in state history.

_Sound like dramatic results for $1 a year? _ **_That’s because career politicians have been conditioning you to settle for less. _**They have made us accustomed to failure and used to excuses. But we don’t have to settle.
---
[ **YES! I REFUSE TO SETTLE**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c91ae4062b5a438fb2054125fe3bc571&_e=0OLbQAkDz4uT9gOmOeyqFdB6gHDkNrVqcUwHJ6Jf5UB_5fYYcMHeO95m4TG2JZUA02ZEWzHHFVKGFq25_1HbbIBqx2_ZgDJSS5Jeu-pwIH1bAkoB80TeZHN87j8tRT_5h2QgCBcFBSfWucgYBkERHDPjGNeVV1HSppnDfib6Rzd348kS3sE9VHqJp6T2rBSgQaacdK0yOO2VSwAhT0E5TJCHBzPEXmAPgk0My2MiKNcUzNcYctgulgsmQ0umqaXJDClgFDpudHtNc6efVeRjjp9kMaodApAiG8lg5LRLBQ1G336g2t7ZescOnu5txofoNh7Cf_iH5AGPtb8uqCCAOOlZENrd2VQ1EVyjtCM2I-Y%3D)
---
I made it my mission to show what complete nonsense that is. **Indiana has UNLIMITED potential, and Hoosiers deserve someone willing to fight for it.** And Peter, I will fight for it. I’m new to this. I’ve never run for office before, so I’m running my campaign a little differently. Instead of canned soundbites, I’m laying out detailed policy plans. And they are not just about how I plan to tackle our problems. It’s bigger than that. I have a bold, positive vision that will actually build the Indiana of the future. We need to stop shrugging our shoulders and accepting that crime is rising, our education system is broken, and Indiana’s best days are behind us. _I know Indiana can be even better. And I REFUSE to settle._ Do you refuse to settle, too? **Then I have a challenge for you:**_[**Join my campaign with whatever you can give.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c91ae4062b5a438fb2054125fe3bc571&_e=0OLbQAkDz4uT9gOmOeyqFdB6gHDkNrVqcUwHJ6Jf5UB_5fYYcMHeO95m4TG2JZUA02ZEWzHHFVKGFq25_1HbbIBqx2_ZgDJSS5Jeu-pwIH1bAkoB80TeZHN87j8tRT_5h2QgCBcFBSfWucgYBkERHDPjGNeVV1HSppnDfib6Rzd348kS3sE9VHqJp6T2rBSgQaacdK0yOO2VSwAhT0E5TD2DbQPL99k3kigz4so8boc3sQIXs4cCrAuWu9u-5PIu4Or9d8z9fB2CATqf8P77n21TkMwXr2571ufcuqR5vNMaZkAY8ssK7AniNOn1baydnrHXJ2yKBeuF3fIVVc5e3Vg6FaEUK-fcpFY7iMRdDjI%3D)_**** Read our plans and follow our campaign journey. I promise you, your donation will pay dividends for the future of Indiana.
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c91ae4062b5a438fb2054125fe3bc571&_e=0OLbQAkDz4uT9gOmOeyqFdB6gHDkNrVqcUwHJ6Jf5UB_5fYYcMHeO95m4TG2JZUA02ZEWzHHFVKGFq25_1HbbIBqx2_ZgDJSS5Jeu-pwIH1bAkoB80TeZHN87j8tRT_5h2QgCBcFBSfWucgYBkERHDPjGNeVV1HSppnDfib6Rzd348kS3sE9VHqJp6T2rBSgQaacdK0yOO2VSwAhT0E5TFRHtzlQ94GKbG7qmQ45QRQS2OG_P-R3oAIqgPjm5w4Q8pRFyy_8qGXLM_up-zdbU2HA5w29cwWhpQMZfcE1OFmIVHpJroVWJtVWxVUgd21fz8PZJEXwA6zRz4lBYjV918VCUEvClEbzFbgp9GPQ83s%3D)

_We can’t wait on Washington D.C. to turn things around for us. If we can show the world what a difference a political outsider can make in Indiana, we can start turning this country around, state by state._ I’m ready to lead the way in Indiana. If you’re looking for a self-made businessman, conservative, and political outsider to get the job done, **I hope you’ll join our team today.**

_Ohio-13 Race Updates_

Friend,

For as long as I’ve been in public service, I’ve been laser-focused on standards and accountability for our government’s most powerful institutions – a focus that has only grown more important in the past year when it comes to our U.S. Supreme Court.
Last year, our highest court faced a crisis of confidence: numerous reports of egregious corruption from Justices Thomas and Alito alongside out-of-control, extremist decisions.

This year, the Court will once again be hearing and ruling on some of the most consequential cases in our history. **And yet, there is not a single camera in the courtroom to allow for a real-time broadcast. Not one single visual record. **
In fact, broadcast and visual recordings are barred in many federal courts for outdated and outlandish reasons. Having argued four cases before the U.S. Supreme Court – and many other lower federal courts – I find reading the bench crucial to understanding the Justices. The American people should be afforded this same privilege.
There is judicial resistance to this needed form of accountability, but a bipartisan legislative effort is underway: I'm working on a bill that would mandate real-time broadcasts in the Supreme Court, with safeguards to prevent abuses. Visibility and transparency are vital – for the Court's credibility and the viability of our democracy.

**But as this campaign for transparency gets underway, I need grassroots supporters like you to advocate alongside me:**[**Will you please sign my new petition demanding the U.S. Supreme Court provide a real-time broadcast of its proceedings? I'm counting on your signature before 11:59 p.m. tonight.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78003331/452120719/-1077985351?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk1362-su-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWI0YzgyNGUtMDViZi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8qAh5A6L_jkPgDF8yQqdQYli2yqF3umDn9PboPwXzbI=&emci=be310a22-d7bc-ee11-b660-002248223197&emdi=5b4c824e-05bf-ee11-b660-002248223197&ceid=9329426)
Thank you,

Dick

Peter – I know my team and I have been reaching out a lot this month. I promise this is one of the last emails of the month so I hope you’ll read the whole thing.

The GOP’s dysfunction this month has been _one of the most politically irresponsible things_ I’ve seen my entire career in office. For weeks, House business was shuttered as the MAGA Party bickered about who to elect as House Speaker.

Then, when they finally elected a Speaker, they picked one of the most despicable far-right Members of their party. **Our House Speaker Mike Johnson once wrote in favor of criminalizing homosexuality.**

Peter, as a gay man, it is so disheartening to see these views come to the forefront of US politics time and time again. Sometimes, it feels like we’ve made no progress at all.

But I know I can’t stop fighting._For the young gay kid still in the closet, for the woman scared to have an abortion, for the advocates fighting for a cleaner world_ – **we must keep fighting.**

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jan2024_abs_em.zPsl9O&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC90_20240129_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=5265%2E5257348%2EtEwh1T ]Jon Hamm

Hi Derek, it’s
Jon Hamm.

You may know me better for my role as advertising executive Don Draper on
the show Mad Men, but today I’m writing to talk to you about Adam Schiff
and why we need to support his run for California’s Senate seat.

I believe that this election for California’s next U.S. Senator will shape
the course of our democracy for many years to come.

We need to elect someone who won’t back down from a tough fight and knows
how to get things done.

The twice-impeached, four-times-indicted ex-president’s recklessness and
impulsiveness put this country in peril several times, and we must take
him seriously as a threat to our democracy. Yet time and again, very few
have held him accountable for his actions.

Adam Schiff has. Again and again.

Over the years, I’ve watched Adam do the important work to investigate
Trump, lead the impeachment trial, and hold his feet to the fire for the
January 6th insurrection.

Adam has shown that he doesn’t back down from big fights. He’s defended
our democracy and our shared values throughout his career, and he’ll keep
up those fights in the Senate.

But Trump and his cronies also know this,
Derek. That’s why they continue
to attack Adam on television, on social media, and at their campaign
rallies.

On Friday January 26th, President Biden announced a "Temporary Pause on Pending Approvals of Liquefied Natural Gas Exports." The timing of the announcement, a mere days after the New Hampshire primaries and Biden's abortion rights campaign rally, points to an underlying political motivation for the White House statement. The opening lines of the statement also makes this clear: "[President Biden has been clear that climate change is the existential threat of our time--and we must act with the urgency it demands to protect the future for generations to come. That's why, since Day One, President Biden has led and delivered on the most ambitious climate agenda in history...](https://substack.com/redirect/bd9da488-8a7c-4e81-974c-3cd45169e859?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c9dffa8e-a61b-4624-964e-e279ee32b760?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/statements-releases/2024/01/26/fact-sheet-biden-harris-administration-announces-temporary-pause-on-pending-approvals-of-liquefied-natural-gas-exports/](https://substack.com/redirect/bd9da488-8a7c-4e81-974c-3cd45169e859?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The document, which reads like a campaign flyer, touts the Biden Administration's top climate accomplishments, which include the signing into law of the Inflation Reduction Act, the pursuit of an environmental justice agenda, the cancellation of oil and gas leases while also accelerating permits of clean energy projects, restricting emissions from power plants, and establishing a target that 50% of new cars sold in 2030 will emit zero emissions.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..p8Ox7wBWapHAkVrzI0C_5g1HWPsKDw7_K_-sJsTWVUo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=141121200)
In aggregate, Biden's climate actions are seeking to deter the development of cheap, reliable, and dependable energy sources while they promote and subsidize supposedly "clean" energy production projects. Let's consider the goal moving America towards electric vehicles, with a stated target that 50% of vehicles sold in the United States in 2030 would produce zero emissions. Or what about the Inflation Reduction Act's subsidies for electric vehicles that began in 2022? How will these policies drive different behavior in America and the world and will they ultimately help the environment?
* * *
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e78df974-78ce-48da-af8b-a244e2c427e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |

---
| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/profile/37278065-vikram-mansharamani)| | *
---|---|---
| Jan 7
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/e78df974-78ce-48da-af8b-a244e2c427e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Rather than point to generic statistics, I'm going to use a specific, personal example. In late 2022, I decided to trade in my Jeep Grand Cherokee. At the time, the dealership offered me around $33,000 for the car, which I happily accepted as it was above my expectations and the Kelly Blue Book value -- a sign of the then robust used car market. The salesperson I worked with knew that I liked Wranglers and suggested I consider the new 4xe hybrid electric one. I immediately declined, saying that I preferred cars with a gross vehicle weight rating of over 6000 pounds as they qualify for accelerated depreciation, something that I am able to claim as a self-employed sole-proprietor. The Wrangler, I knew from prior consideration, was less than 6000 pounds.
"Actually, Vikram, the 4xe hybrid wranglers are over 6000 pounds because of the extra weight of the batteries, so you'll qualify!" This meant that the new 4xe Wrangler would cost me less on a tax-adjusted basis than the value of my trade! Wow, that's a deal, I thought, and started examining the inventory at the dealership. The salesperson then chimed in with another tidbit of news, "And don't forget that the Inflation Reduction Act will also give you a $7500 tax credit!" At the end of the day, I ended up getting paid five figures for trading in an old car and getting a brand new one. For all American taxpayers reading this piece, thank you! It was your money that the government transferred to me.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..p8Ox7wBWapHAkVrzI0C_5g1HWPsKDw7_K_-sJsTWVUo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=141121200)
But perhaps these transfers are a useful means to save the environment? Did my gasoline bill go down as my car's efficiency went up? As I analyzed the data, I struggled to find any justification for the government giving me your money to buy this car. It was too hard to gauge the improved fuel efficiency from driving in hybrid mode, but it wasn't significant: I gained a less than one mile per gallon gain when driving in hybrid mode.
I did, however, find a simple measure of the car's supposed benefit: the distance I could travel in electric-only mode. My new hybrid Wrangler had a range of around 21 miles (less on cold days) when in electric mode. That is not a typo. Twenty-one miles. On average, I think the range was probably even less, likely 18 miles or so.
Given I didn't spend the hundreds (thousands?) of dollars to have a fast charger installed in my home, it would take 12-14 hours to charge up the vehicle. My guess (very crude analysis comparing my electricity bill while keeping track of the number of days charging, etc.) suggested it cost me around $4 to fully charge the vehicle each time. (It's worth noting that New Hampshire has some of the highest electricity prices in the country, so this amount may be different elsewhere in the country.)
So what does this mean? Given that gasoline was under $4/gallon at the time and the vehicle was regularly getting more than 23 miles per gallon, I concluded that I was losing money every time I charged the vehicle. So I stopped, and I began using it as a traditional gasoline vehicle, albeit one that was heavier than it should have been. And in return for having the government pay part of the cost of the car, I had the privilege of driving a vehicle that put extra wear and tear on roads and bridges.

[](https://substack.com/redirect/e78df974-78ce-48da-af8b-a244e2c427e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |

| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/profile/37278065-vikram-mansharamani)| | *

| Jan 7
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/e78df974-78ce-48da-af8b-a244e2c427e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
It's pretty clear to me that my hybrid Jeep Wrangler didn't make economic sense without government subsidies and probably put an unnecessary burden on New Hampshire's infrastructure. But it likely also hurt the environment. When we look at the supply chain for batteries, I'm pretty sure that producing the car had a bigger environmental footprint than that of a traditional gasoline car.
And of course, let's not forget that electric vehicles don't produce power! Batteries are storage devices. An already overtaxed grid that included natural gas and coal fired power plants was providing the electricity to charge the batteries. Let's also not forget that extra demand for electricity from electric vehicles would mean (all else equal) higher electricity prices for everyone.

While I'm all for clean air and water and a better environment and healthier earth, I'm absolutely opposed to the inanity of bad policy (labeled "accomplishments" by some) that doesn't help the environment or the economy and instead is a de facto tax on some and subsidy to others. My Jeep arguably hurt both the environment and the economy when you factor in the battery supply chain footprint, extra infrastructure maintenance costs, and the additional burden on an aging electricity grid.
Given these facts, it's only logical to ask why such policies gain momentum or ever get written into law. The short answer, I believe, is politics. You see, even though voters consistently place the economy and immigration concerns way above climate change as a motivating issue, the climate may be turning into a "swing" issue. [A recent report from the University of Colorado at Boulder suggests that voters focused on climate change may in fact have been instrumental in the 2020 election](https://substack.com/redirect/d51b0a6d-95e2-4fd8-9315-099f04974996?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [A recent Bloomberg opinion piece was even titled "The 2024 Election Just Might Turn on ... Climate Change?"](https://substack.com/redirect/cbc950fd-84bc-4847-9057-0eb93f74ca6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and suggested not focusing on the climate would hurt candidates because "it's also possible that voters are starting to realize climate change has a growing impact on the [economy](https://substack.com/redirect/30923c72-281f-4d6f-92a7-aaaa292b176b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [public health](https://substack.com/redirect/72b41561-97b1-40a9-8a58-211082264578?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [immigration](https://substack.com/redirect/6e90b9c3-7fcd-430f-b818-abd71b82499a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and more."

Because climate change is seemingly a far more important issue to Democrats than to Republicans, the LNG Pause Statement may really be about President Biden catering to his core base of supporters. But it also may be about interfering with the normal functioning of energy markets for domestic political gain. On the margin, restricting potential exports of natural gas would leave more natural gas in America, and all else equal, more natural gas in America would equate to lower prices. This would reduce inflation and help consumer budgets going into an election cycle. [I doubt, however, that it would help the environment](https://substack.com/redirect/183f454e-35a2-46f2-9b72-412e316733da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as I wrote in the below piece:

It's also important to note climate change is a global phenomenon that has the potential to impact everyone on this planet, even if different regions may feel the impact in different ways or at different times. As such, it's foolish to merely look through a domestic-only lens to understand climate dynamics. The geopolitics of climate change are also important. It's also useful to remember, as I've written and spoken about for some time, that the United States and China are in the midst of a great power war, even if it hasn't (yet) turned kinetic.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..p8Ox7wBWapHAkVrzI0C_5g1HWPsKDw7_K_-sJsTWVUo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=141121200)
China has agreed that it will begin reducing its carbon emissions by 2030, meaning for the next six years or so, the Middle Kingdom is likely to rapidly increase its carbon output. In fact, [in April 2021, Chinese President Xi Jinping explicitly pledged to "strictly control coal-fired power generation projects."](https://substack.com/redirect/33df4c5c-20c5-4a32-89e6-40f83cb8165b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Since then, however, China has been rapidly increasing its use of coal to power its economy.
According to data from the [Global Energy Monitor](https://substack.com/redirect/c900f9ed-7cf0-4f07-8483-8703a882817f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), China[ had approved 127 coal plants capable of producing 54 gigawatts of power in the two years prior to Xi's statement ](https://substack.com/redirect/6788c9b1-e8ea-4eae-9616-524db83d402b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to the Leaders Summit on Climate. In the two years after his pledge, [China approved 182 coal plants with aggregate power production capacity of 131 gigawatts](https://substack.com/redirect/6788c9b1-e8ea-4eae-9616-524db83d402b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Rather than cutting back on coal, China is rapidly increasing its use. In fact, [NPR noted in 2023 that Beijing is building the equivalent of two new coal fired power plants per week](https://substack.com/redirect/92972a43-7941-45c3-9153-fbcad35d80ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), roughly six times the rest of the world combined. Words aside, China's actions indicate the country has opted to prioritize economics over the environment. The Chinese are doing this at precisely the same time that they claim to be "committed" to leading the global energy transition.
So how does the LNG Export Pause factor into the US-China War? The statement clearly states that the US "[remains unwavering in our commitment to supporting our allies around the world...[and the] announcement will not impact our ability to continue supplying LNG to our allies in the near-term](https://substack.com/redirect/bd9da488-8a7c-4e81-974c-3cd45169e859?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." While promising, the statement seems oblivious to the fact that energy commodities operate in a global market, meaning trade patterns will shift and global energy prices will likely rise.

Yes, America will supply Europe to decrease their dependence on Moscow, but that means Moscow's production will fill in the gaps where we've pulled back. And because less US supplies on global markets will mean higher prices, Moscow will be among the world's biggest beneficiaries of reduced LNG exports from America. Given Russia's relationship with China, this is also an indirect "win" for Beijing. Rather than enabling American energy dominance to increase American power and influence in the world, the Biden administration seem to be waving a white flag.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..p8Ox7wBWapHAkVrzI0C_5g1HWPsKDw7_K_-sJsTWVUo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=141121200)
There are also currency implications. As the Chinese-led economic ecosystem seeks an alternative to the US dollar, LNG exports from the US could be way a healthy way to increase demand for the greenback. Why reduce demand for US dollars at a moment when America is well positioned to increase the importance of our currency for global trade? From a currency statecraft perspective, this sure seems like an unforced error, incrementally helping Beijing and others as the world becomes less dependent upon the US dollar.

* * *
And let's not forget that building and maintaining LNG infrastructure in the United States is a major economic engine that will create jobs, drive demand for supporting services, and spur meaningful economic activity up and down the supply chain of natural gas as well as the communities in which facilities are built. And all of that will occur without any government subsidies. All we need to do is have the government get out of the way to unleash American entrepreneurial energy.
An unfortunate reality is that climate politics have become more important that climate policy. My guess is that most people care about the air they breathe, the water they drink, and the planet they live upon. It's unclear if politicians do. But voters are smart and can see through inane policies that make little sense for the environment or the economy. It's high time to move beyond climate politics and focus on energy policies that prioritize America's long term interests in a strong economy, clean environment, and a safer world.

An irrational focus on climate politics is creating bad policies | | | Jan 30 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- On Friday January 26th, President Biden announced a "Temporary Pause on Pending Approvals of Liquefied Natural Gas Exports." The timing of the announcement, a mere days after the New Hampshire primaries and Biden's abortion rights campaign rally, points to an underlying political motivation for the White House statement. The opening lines of the statement also makes this clear: "" | | ---|---|--- Source: The document, which reads like a campaign flyer, touts the Biden Administration's top climate accomplishments, which include the signing into law of the Inflation Reduction Act, the pursuit of an environmental justice agenda, the cancellation of oil and gas leases while also accelerating permits of clean energy projects, restricting emissions from power plants, and establishing a target that 50% of new cars sold in 2030 will emit zero emissions. In aggregate, Biden's climate actions are seeking to deter the development of cheap, reliable, and dependable energy sources while they promote and subsidize supposedly "clean" energy production projects. Let's consider the goal moving America towards electric vehicles, with a stated target that 50% of vehicles sold in the United States in 2030 would produce zero emissions. Or what about the Inflation Reduction Act's subsidies for electric vehicles that began in 2022? How will these policies drive different behavior in America and the world and will they ultimately help the environment? | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Jan 7 | Rather than point to generic statistics, I'm going to use a specific, personal example. In late 2022, I decided to trade in my Jeep Grand Cherokee. At the time, the dealership offered me around $33,000 for the car, which I happily accepted as it was above my expectations and the Kelly Blue Book value -- a sign of the then robust used car market. The salesperson I worked with knew that I liked Wranglers and suggested I consider the new 4xe hybrid electric one. I immediately declined, saying that I preferred cars with a gross vehicle weight rating of over 6000 pounds as they qualify for accelerated depreciation, something that I am able to claim as a self-employed sole-proprietor. The Wrangler, I knew from prior consideration, was less than 6000 pounds. "Actually, Vikram, the 4xe hybrid wranglers are over 6000 pounds because of the extra weight of the batteries, so you'll qualify!" This meant that the new 4xe Wrangler would cost me less on a tax-adjusted basis than the value of my trade! Wow, that's a deal, I thought, and started examining the inventory at the dealership. The salesperson then chimed in with another tidbit of news, "And don't forget that the Inflation Reduction Act will also give you a $7500 tax credit!" At the end of the day, I ended up getting paid five figures for trading in an old car and getting a brand new one. For all American taxpayers reading this piece, thank you! It was your money that the government transferred to me. But perhaps these transfers are a useful means to save the environment? Did my gasoline bill go down as my car's efficiency went up? As I analyzed the data, I struggled to find any justification for the government giving me your money to buy this car. It was too hard to gauge the improved fuel efficiency from driving in hybrid mode, but it wasn't significant: I gained a less than one mile per gallon gain when driving in hybrid mode. I did, however, find a simple measure of the car's supposed benefit: the distance I could travel in electric-only mode. My new hybrid Wrangler had a range of around 21 miles (less on cold days) when in electric mode. That is not a typo. Twenty-one miles. On average, I think the range was probably even less, likely 18 miles or so. Given I didn't spend the hundreds (thousands?) of dollars to have a fast charger installed in my home, it would take 12-14 hours to charge up the vehicle. My guess (very crude analysis comparing my electricity bill while keeping track of the number of days charging, etc.) suggested it cost me around $4 to fully charge the vehicle each time. (It's worth noting that New Hampshire has some of the highest electricity prices in the country, so this amount may be different elsewhere in the country.) So what does this mean? Given that gasoline was under $4/gallon at the time and the vehicle was regularly getting more than 23 miles per gallon, I concluded that I was losing money every time I charged the vehicle. So I stopped, and I began using it as a traditional gasoline vehicle, albeit one that was heavier than it should have been. And in return for having the government pay part of the cost of the car, I had the privilege of driving a vehicle that put extra wear and tear on roads and bridges. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Jan 7 | It's pretty clear to me that my hybrid Jeep Wrangler didn't make economic sense without government subsidies and probably put an unnecessary burden on New Hampshire's infrastructure. But it likely also hurt the environment. When we look at the supply chain for batteries, I'm pretty sure that producing the car had a bigger environmental footprint than that of a traditional gasoline car. And of course, let's not forget that electric vehicles don't produce power! Batteries are storage devices. An already overtaxed grid that included natural gas and coal fired power plants was providing the electricity to charge the batteries. Let's also not forget that extra demand for electricity from electric vehicles would mean (all else equal) higher electricity prices for everyone. While I'm all for clean air and water and a better environment and healthier earth, I'm absolutely opposed to the inanity of bad policy (labeled "accomplishments" by some) that doesn't help the environment or the economy and instead is a de facto tax on some and subsidy to others. My Jeep arguably hurt both the environment and the economy when you factor in the battery supply chain footprint, extra infrastructure maintenance costs, and the additional burden on an aging electricity grid. China has agreed that it will begin reducing its carbon emissions by 2030, meaning for the next six years or so, the Middle Kingdom is likely to rapidly increase its carbon output. In fact, Since then, however, China has been rapidly increasing its use of coal to power its economy. According to data from the , China the Leaders Summit on Climate. In the two years after his pledge, . Rather than cutting back on coal, China is rapidly increasing its use. In fact, , roughly six times the rest of the world combined. Words aside, China's actions indicate the country has opted to prioritize economics over the environment. The Chinese are doing this at precisely the same time that they claim to be "committed" to leading the global energy transition. So how does the LNG Export Pause factor into the US-China War? The statement clearly states that the US "[remains unwavering in our commitment to supporting our allies around the world...[and the] announcement will not impact our ability to continue supplying LNG to our allies in the near-term]()." While promising, the statement seems oblivious to the fact that energy commodities operate in a global market, meaning trade patterns will shift and global energy prices will likely rise. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Jan 7 | Yes, America will supply Europe to decrease their dependence on Moscow, but that means Moscow's production will fill in the gaps where we've pulled back. And because less US supplies on global markets will mean higher prices, Moscow will be among the world's biggest beneficiaries of reduced LNG exports from America. Given Russia's relationship with China, this is also an indirect "win" for Beijing. Rather than enabling American energy dominance to increase American power and influence in the world, the Biden administration seem to be waving a white flag. There are also currency implications. As the Chinese-led economic ecosystem seeks an alternative to the US dollar, LNG exports from the US could be way a healthy way to increase demand for the greenback. Why reduce demand for US dollars at a moment when America is well positioned to increase the importance of our currency for global trade? From a currency statecraft perspective, this sure seems like an unforced error, incrementally helping Beijing and others as the world becomes less dependent upon the US dollar. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Jan 7 | And let's not forget that building and maintaining LNG infrastructure in the United States is a major economic engine that will create jobs, drive demand for supporting services, and spur meaningful economic activity up and down the supply chain of natural gas as well as the communities in which facilities are built. And all of that will occur without any government subsidies. All we need to do is have the government get out of the way to unleash American entrepreneurial energy. An unfortunate reality is that climate politics have become more important that climate policy. My guess is that most people care about the air they breathe, the water they drink, and the planet they live upon. It's unclear if politicians do. But voters are smart and can see through inane policies that make little sense for the environment or the economy. It's high time to move beyond climate politics and focus on energy policies that prioritize America's long term interests in a strong economy, clean environment, and a safer world. Barely 10 months remain before a presidential election that many observers believe will either vindicate--or instead destroy--democracy in America. Those voices may have good reasons to cling to their unfounded optimism, but their vision remains sugarcoated nonetheless.
Democracy has no friends among the major parties' candidates.
### **Setting the stage**
[Part one of this series](https://substack.com/redirect/0edd7200-3be8-4b0c-b9f4-2f7ce50c501a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) addressed how each of the major parties' presidential candidates have openly violated any pretense of respecting democracy. Both have chosen to duck debates, and refuse to accept the legitimacy of primary elections. Both remain repeatedly indulged by compliant journalists who seem more dedicated to [promoting the establishment and building cults of personality](https://substack.com/redirect/2f7a7fa4-a341-4c8b-b3d8-1313f031c2a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than promoting transparency or accountability.
[Part two](https://substack.com/redirect/0b6ac008-d552-4b4f-88dd-9aa273e010a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) examined the unfortunate tendency of recent Democratic presidents to embrace Republican policies, and what that suggests about visions of democracy in America. It reflected on the legacy of Martin Luther King, Jr, whose warnings and wisdom--which remain more salient today than ever--offered a way for America to avoid the trap into which it was led by its own ignorance.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6b584795-dd5f-468c-98ec-4554627f92cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This installment will examine the role of the [militarism shared](https://substack.com/redirect/36d42d2f-5a51-4633-921c-48addb951b1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Democrats and Republicans in fulfilling the [terrifying prophecy](https://substack.com/redirect/a813c70a-9ee2-43b7-b77b-8334d1aaab31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of President Dwight Eisenhower. Eisenhower was ironically the last war hero to win the White House, and issued a prolific warning in 1961 that an ignorant nation tragically forgot immediately. He [warned](https://substack.com/redirect/a483b4be-564f-4468-864a-0b1933a50f46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), in no uncertain terms, that:
> In the councils of government, we must guard against the acquisition of unwarranted influence, whether sought or unsought, by the military-industrial complex. The potential for the disastrous rise of misplaced power exists and will persist. We must never let the weight of this combination endanger our liberties or democratic processes.We should take nothing for granted.

Fears of a fascist future are entirely legitimate. They are also rose colored, overlooking the contemporary reality in the United States that too many writers lack the independence to recognize.
### **Biden supports genocide**
Any number of voices in Washington have tried to spin the reality that is all too obvious to the rest of the world: Israel continues to violate human rights, and its violations grow more outrageous with every passing day. Yet both parties in Washington remain committed to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu despite his belligerence, and none of them support either the international law or human rights principles adopted [after](https://substack.com/redirect/d1a94135-1cf7-4f3e-833b-3c0d7b96242a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Second World War.
In that context, it is even more disingenuous to suggest that democracy is on the ballot this November. Democracy has no friends among the major parties' candidates.
Last week, the International Court of Justice (ICJ) [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/ba4fd089-29ad-4a61-8136-28b547084531?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its interim ruling favoring South Africa's legal challenge to Israel's genocide in Gaza. The opinion, which [Washington and Tel Aviv have spun to their benefit](https://substack.com/redirect/a4637a81-d703-4904-919a-300ea5607b79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) despite its scathing terms recognizing Israel's actions as genocidal, should surprise no one. South Africa overcame its own legacy of apartheid more recently than any other state, and has international credibility to observes its similarities in the only remaining state in the world that continues to embrace it.
First, it's worth remembering that Israel's occupation of Palestine has [long been illegal](https://substack.com/redirect/9aa37ab2-d2ee-4074-8d00-57e79a707027?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to begin with. It was the refusal to recognize repeated United Nations resolutions calling for human rights--and Washington's [repeated use of its veto](https://substack.com/redirect/04b75161-875d-447d-954e-3b7481b23414?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the U.N. Security Council to allow Israel to ignore international human rights--that prompted [the October 7 attacks](https://substack.com/redirect/d459158f-12bb-4ad1-9886-1283589503fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that shocked the Israeli defense establishment.
Second, the scale of death & destruction in Gaza at the hands of Israeli authorities can not be overstated. The Associated Press has [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/5261855b-04e4-48a0-aa76-f91ec93d0bcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Israel has "wreaked more destruction [in Gaza since October 2023] than the razing of Syria's Aleppo between 2012 and 2016, Ukraine's Mariupol or, proportionally, the Allied bombing of Germany in World War II."
Few observers abroad recall that Israeli commanders were [warned](https://substack.com/redirect/8fec8c05-bf28-4d01-9fe6-3f89e8ffdcf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the October 7 attacks in advance, or that IDF commanders [shamelessly](https://substack.com/redirect/56779134-b022-480b-b836-836c23dbd5cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ordered the deaths of Israelis taken prisoner by Hamas in order to avoid the political inconvenience of bargaining for their lives. Many remain under the illusion of [documented disinformation](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea7e876-29eb-4011-8f7b-4714d1742b2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) promoted by Western journalists and President Biden, himself.
The ICJ is relatively immune from the political bias favoring Israel that pervades both Congress and the ranks of American journalists who [pretend](https://substack.com/redirect/e342ba40-f9ff-491d-b873-860b125e4a67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to be free and uncontrolled from Washington. Its ruling reveals its independence, and just how internationally isolated Washington & Tel Aviv have grown over the course of the past three months.
Of course, neither Tel Aviv nor Washington accepts the ICJ's jurisdiction. Their rejection reveals that, despite the convenient pretenses of leaders who claim to follow a "[rules-based order](https://substack.com/redirect/cd841055-6e34-4e7d-a07a-24b3aad13330?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," might makes right in the world today.

### **What would MLK Do?**
Earlier this month, America celebrated a holiday dedicated to a [civic prophet and national hero](https://substack.com/redirect/ec9d264e-5dbb-45c3-b69d-87d0618b4827?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): the Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.
People who claim that Biden is a lesser evil, and perceive that as a sufficient basis to support him because Trump also appears on the ballot, might learn something from reading Dr. King's [Letter from a Birmingham Jail](https://substack.com/redirect/190e5a7c-189d-42af-86bf-987a7665066e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
_[Frequent readers of this column might find that reference familiar, since I invoke it often. The Letter from Birmingham Jail is among the most crucial political texts in U.S. history, yet writers across the country reveal their ignorance of it --and MLK's legacy--on a daily basis.]_
MLK's letter from jail was an invitation 60 years ago for White America to learn what solidarity means. But, sadly, "the...moderate" decried by MLK remains all too willing to abandon urgent calls for long overdue justice from communities confronting escalating crises from economic precarity and homelessness to [state violence from Ferguson to Jerusalem](https://substack.com/redirect/cf2df100-097a-4ac1-8e55-02ddd2936e0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Dr. King's timeless legacy [remains suppressed](https://substack.com/redirect/23fc4e11-22c8-4d94-83fd-0e945efb7e44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), even while his memory has become the object of widespread acclaim. He would roll in his grave at the choices presented to voters by Democrats who today [mouth his words](https://substack.com/redirect/390f77bb-fdec-4bd1-b403-66b41479b0a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) while undermining his vision. It's no mystery to me who he would be supporting today, were he allowed to live his life, unfettered by a documented [FBI plot](https://substack.com/redirect/2a4a5d4c-4d1b-44b6-8084-05cea00c2e71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to drive him to an early grave.
He certainly wouldn't support a president enabling a genocide while absurdly claiming to be progressive.

MLK would more likely stand with the voice who has spent decades championing the same vision that he promoted. [One candidate in the 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/9c61bfd4-ecd9-458a-80fc-3eecf92de89f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) election stands in Dr. King's shoes, and he has no peer in either politics or the academy. Yet you won't hear much about Dr. Cornel West in election coverage, because journalists and editors in the U.S. are widely dedicated to suppressing the transparency on which democracy relies.
### **Gaslighting the public**
Biden continues to duck debates, perhaps because his record is indefensible, and Democrats can't tolerate dissent.
Meanwhile, he also follows the strategy practiced by Clinton and Obama, each of whom embraced policies once favored only by conservatives in order to invite support from donors and voters friendly to Wall Street.
But beyond supporting Republican policies, and disrespecting the democratic process, Biden has also openly rejected international human rights by unapologetically supporting the ongoing Israeli genocide in Gaza.
Many liberals will pretend that Biden is better than Trump. That's easy for them because Biden's bombs aren't killing their family members.

| Peter,

Last week, Donald Trump won the New Hampshire Republican primary, putting him one step closer to becoming the Republican nominee.

In the four years he was in office, he set the foundation for overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , weakened our social safety net, and led the January 6th insurrection. Dear Peter,
We’re at a crucial juncture – our first important deadline of 2024 is just two days away. We urgently need your support.
Our goal is to champion the needs of working parents, both in California and nationwide, and we believe Katie Porter is an ideal candidate for the US Senate.
Here’s an exciting opportunity: A group of generous donors will triple-match every donation received, effective until midnight on January 31st.
This means your contribution of $5, $25, or even $100 will have three times the usual impact, providing a substantial boost for our efforts throughout 2024. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/momsforkatie]
Your support could make all the difference. Let’s take this chance to advance our common goals.
Thank you for your commitment.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: I don’t know anymore
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

With everything Students for Life Action has on our plates right now and a lack of resources, I’m facing some very hard choices about our 2024 programs.

Can you click here [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240129] or on the button below to fill out your Supporter Ballot and tell me which program I should cut?

SUPPORTER BALLOT [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240129]

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

President, Students for Life Action

body:
Last year, Texans were told that the Texas Legislature had passed an $18 billion property tax cut, the largest tax cut in Texas history. It turns out this was not the case.
No images? [Click here](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-e-ellhyuy-yuddtktydi-c/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ellhyuy-yuddtktydi-r/) **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Press Manager
Contact: [Press@HuffinesLiberty.com](mailto:Press@HuffinesLiberty.com)
## **New Property Tax Numbers Show Texas Legislature Failed to Deliver a Property Tax Cut**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ellhyuy-yuddtktydi-y/) DALLAS, TX, January 29, 2024 -- Today, the Huffines Liberty Foundation is releasing its latest report, _[Texas Legislature Fails to Deliver a Property Tax Cut.](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ellhyuy-yuddtktydi-j/)_ Last year, Texans were told that the Texas Legislature had passed an $18 billion property tax cut, the largest tax cut in Texas history. It turns out this was _not_ the case.**So what happened to the $18 billion?** Read our full report to learn why property tax revenue increased, how much relief homeowners actually got, why renters and businesses saw little to no relief, and how Texas can still eliminate school property taxes: [Read Report](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ellhyuy-yuddtktydi-t/) **JUST IN:** Don Huffines' latest op-ed in The Telegraph: [_Biden should know better than to start a fight with Texas_](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ellhyuy-yuddtktydi-i/) _._ [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ellhyuy-yuddtktydi-h/) [Read Op-ed](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-ellhyuy-yuddtktydi-k/) The Huffines Liberty Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, non-partisan research institute. Our mission is to advance the cause of **liberty** , **prosperity** , and **virtue** in the State of Texas by educating and equipping citizens so they may hold their elected officials accountable and better informed to tackle the toughest challenges.###

subject: Breaking: Biden intends to sign UN Gun Ban
body:

Please read the message below from our sponsor.

Steve Thompson, Editor

* * *

|
---
| | | | | | |
---
|

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The United Nations’ “Small Arms Treaty” has been the Gun Control Lobby’s crown jewel for decades.

They’ve been waiting for an anti-gun President, like Joe Biden, to take the White House **so they can launch an all-out effort to ratify it in the U.S. Senate**.

Now, they think they finally see their opportunity to _ram it through_!

But you and I have a chance to stop them cold -- **[as long as we take IMMEDIATE action to help dismantle this dangerous Treaty](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=5ggd00ms46xzovi4tkebciv79qgd4jk9nsrvk73owl985s9w6iekxaj321hxz8ep0m79ykrndu63gjfrc2iey1h7cem9c5w648xjgj3saugvuzs6rjzgp63iwbdbq1qbiigfwu058fsztg31qz6hu9qv3gj6rwzojj7vo8guj8f20q7pdtb&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=s82wy6)**.

As Dudley Brown, President of the National Association for Gun Rights, explains in the email below, it’s absolutely critical we act now!

**Sincerely,

The Hon. Rand Paul
U.S. Senator (R-KY)**

* * *

Fellow Patriot,
**“BIDEN AIMS TO SIGN ON TO UN'S GLOBAL GUN REGISTRATION TREATY.”**
That was the headline in the _Washington Examiner_ shortly after President Biden’s State Department spokesman told international bureaucrats of “the continuing commitment of the United States” to the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” during the gun control Conference of State Parties in Geneva, Switzerland.

Just a few weeks later, President Biden himself spoke before the United Nations in New York City, stating: _“We’ll continue to uphold the long-standing rules and norms... Bedrock commitments,**like support for arms control measures** to reduce the risk and enhance transparency.”_ Fellow Patriot, anyone hoping that President Biden wouldn’t use his bully pulpit to RAM the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” down the throats of Americans just got those hopes CRUSHED.

The battle over implementation of the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” -- the crown jewel in the gun grabbers’ designs for the globe -- is about to reach a fever pitch.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to tell your U.S. Senators “NO UN GUN BAN” at once](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=5ggd00ms46xzovi4tkebciv79qgd4jk9sxohmi4ojhro1yoj25enlbxnedwnz7uz3bcj9dlhquqczb3whd7twagpeblbd8ci9qhwewky7oskttjrve65ym9vxnug5ttljrkadvpa0f2l7z6zevfe4erzf46sl3vlpex3xwjdzsrnilhx2x2&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=s82wy6)**!

As you’ll see, this survey insists that your U.S. Senators do everything in their power to oppose the UN “Small Arms Treaty” in the U.S. Senate.

_If there’s anything we’ve learned, it’s that globalists have been telling LIES about the supposed “need’ for the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” for years_.

From the beginning, gun grabbers have claimed the purpose of the Treaty is keeping arms out of the hands of terrorists, insurgents, rogue states, and gang members.

But at the very same time the Biden Administration was pledging their support for the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty,” they were leaving $83 BILLION in U.S. military weaponry to the Taliban!

They don’t care about keeping guns out of the hands of terrorists.

_They care about keeping guns out of the hands of law-abiding Americans_!

Reading through the details of the UN “Small Arms Treaty,” it’s hard to see how our Second Amendment could survive, if ratified.

For starters, the Treaty text demands the U.S. identify “end users” (gun buyers), document “the quantity, value, and model/type” of firearms and ammunition, and develop “national control standards” to regulate transfers.

_In other words, by design it’s an International Gun Registry that’ll include detailed information on American gun owners just like you -- the first step toward outright CONFISCATION_.

Worse, all that information would be made accessible by despots and foreign governments including the Treaty's largest signer -- Communist China.

**[As you can see, it’s vital you sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to your U.S. Senators demanding they reject this scheme](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=5ggd00ms46xzovi4tkebciv79qgd4jk9xcm6zx5pmdxrjes9jqdbpc9wvt91z68j75mwixwr1uzpsspc1ru6vnfvgzb5enjyqx57c8fdc63psoqazyashqr6xj9kijx9jl2vkwd6eebmjsmm6ssadnseuprduysxfzkzgj10pa1xfxvepbi&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=s82wy6)**!

Once a nation signs on, the UN’s goal is to quickly impose “International Small Arms Control Standards” (ISACS) on them. Introductory language already includes: *** _Mandated national “screening” for those seeking to own guns_ , giving bureaucrats the final say on whether or not you’re “competent” enough to own a firearm; *** _Restrictive licensing for gun and ammo sales_ , and perhaps even bans on anything from semi-auto rifles to shotguns and handguns; *** _Restrictions on the number of guns and amount of ammo any “properly-licensed” individual may legally own_ ; *** _Bans on magazines holding more than ten rounds_ ; and *** _Bans on owning a firearm for self-defense_ \-- unless a citizen can somehow get government approval (which will only happen if you’re “connected” -- or paid half-a-million dollars for one of Hunter Biden’s paintings). Believe me, the United Nations has no intention of slow walking any of this.

To them, your Second Amendment freedoms are a threat to their grand “utopian” designs.

Enemies like Red China are so eager to see every American disarmed, they’re pouring money into the UN “Small Arms Treaty” hand-over-fist.

_So, it’s no wonder why they’re hell-bent on forcing the U.S. to submit to this globalist gun control scam -- and why we must defeat it_!

**[I’m counting on you to help beat the UN by signing your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to your U.S. Senators](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=5ggd00ms46xzovi4tkebciv79qgd4jk9ch7u0m6pzzdvfkvyezd2dcjfm6jdz4l7mwg8vr4kaui097zh73ehtkebixqxfr4ovdqgziaj8lber6hjdt6e4uwfyv13apavku6r5y4bwenyz9piwp3xpgtj7yb225p89vo849493hzhc77lafy&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=s82wy6)**.

As soon the gun grabbers have 67 votes to ratify the Treaty in the U.S. Senate, you can bet Biden’s pal, Sen. Chuck Schumer, will call for the vote.

But we can’t wait until then to fight back because even now, one-world bureaucrats are pushing these gun controls deep into every part of government.

_On top of Biden’s ATF anti-gun executive actions, a headline from _The Hill_ shows how “Democrats’ latest backdoor plan to limit gun ownership” involves new State Department “sanctions” designed to drive the price of ammo by BANNING imports_.

That’s the same State Department which NAGR caught red-handed trying to siphon your tax dollars into funding the UN “Small Arms Treaty.”

_Worse, since day one of the COVID-19 outbreak, our court system has said yes to almost any politician cooking up any unconstitutional idea so long as it’s under the guise of “public health_.”

So now Biden’s Center for Disease Control (CDC) is pushing a new Euro-centric gun control framework that says _“Using a public health approach is essential to addressing firearm violence and keeping people safe and healthy.”_

That’s why insisting that your U.S. Senators OPPOSE the ratification of the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” is not enough.

We must insist that the U.S. Senate ensures that NOT ONE TAXPAYER CENT is spent by Biden on implementing any part of this Treaty or what it stands for.

But I’m counting on your help to send that message -- before it’s too late.

**[First, please sign your OFFICIAL FIREARMS SOVEREIGNTY SURVEY to tell your U.S. Senators “NO UN GUN BAN” at once](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=5ggd00ms46xzovi4tkebciv79qgd4jk9i04fol7q0vjzc4ylzics5dy20iytz3btq0pi68bunv4z1kk0oe3wsxdhkv41gun2ajatxww2dfo7q1p6hnb3pycsz4e8rfdfl1mmozu8odjkp2tuk9cu0pv1ihkoxa9gbqbepx7tg3m5yei6ljq&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=s82wy6)**.

Second, please agree to your most generous contribution to help the National Association for Gun Rights mobilize a grassroots firestorm against the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” -- using everything from _U.S. Mail_ , to _phones_ , to _email_ , _blogs_ , and _guest editorials_ , _hard-hitting video_ and even _paid media_ if we can raise resources.

If at all possible, I’m hoping you’ll agree to $100.

I know that’s a lot to ask for, believe me. But the fight is here, Fellow Patriot. It’s on. There’s no time to wait.

**[But if $100 is just too much -- even given the urgency of the situation -- please agree to $30, or at least $15 TODAY](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xtl=4h5n6m1og8rnuez4vlh33ch9w5no4f203xqd02vw479m6rjndihurmqscoua02uaa3uyvfvdtaho0bj0k044ys9gz9lugbtdon0n131pssb10wkigx9h61mtunk6mgs8wqyxuwnjcu9npjus3x0dnsd3mfkuyf1levzhtjk7uxwntu2m5mnnto2y5g40f287f0gwafqxkl1qggxbbo&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=s82wy6)**.

Whatever you can do, please act IMMEDIATELY. There’s no time to waste.

**For Freedom,

Dudley Brown
President
National Association for Gun Rights**

# Take your Health Back!
Alright, everybody, strap in because I've got something absolutely mind-blowing to share with you, especially all my folks in California and the surrounding areas. This is not your average health benefit – we're talking about a game-changer! Now, I've been through the wringer when it comes to health. Yeah, I shed a whopping 500 pounds recently, but guess what? Dear friends and fellow Conservatives,
I am thrilled to announce that I am running for an official seat on the 66th Assembly District Central Committee. As some of you may know, I have been serving as an alternate on the committee for some time now. Over the past two years, I have also been actively involved in multiple posts within the party. I am proud to have been elected to the California Republican Assembly state board of directors as the Senate director for the 24th District, chaired the Faith Outreach committee for the CRA, and served as a delegate for the California State party. These experiences have given me a deep understanding of the values and principles that are important to our party and have prepared me to effectively represent our district on the central committee.
As a member of the central committee, I will work tirelessly to ensure that conservative values remain at the forefront of our party's agenda. I believe that my position on the LAGOP, which is the largest Republican party office in the nation, will allow me to have a greater impact on decisions that affect our party and our community. I have already been able to influence many decisions as an alternate, and I am confident that I can make an even greater impact as an elected member.
While some have urged me to run for the congressional seat of the 36th district, I believe that my calling is to bring balance to the party for the next few years. This will not only benefit the party but also other candidates and myself in the long run. Federal races can be expensive to operate, and I have learned from my previous run for Congress that it takes time to build relationships and secure the support needed to win. My goal is to help fix the foundation of the party while building relationships with those who can help me in the future.
I am asking for your prayers and support as I take this important step on my journey. Please look for me on the primary ballot on March 5, 2024. Early voting begins on February 24, 2024. Your vote for me, Derrick R. Gates, for the 66th Assembly Central Committee, will help ensure that our conservative values continue to be represented in our district and beyond.
Thank you for your support and dedication to our party.
Sincerely,
Derrick R. Gates

## Welcome to the MIGOP Newsletter!
Each week, the Michigan Republican Party sends important information about what is happening within the party, state, and nation and how you can get involved.
---
|
---
| | | Hello:

As if we needed further proof that the Left is interfering in the 2024 election, last week, a New York jury [ordered](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=245ac826f0&e=a2af77507c) President Donald Trump to pay $83.3 million to E. Jean Carroll in a civil defamation case. This is an [outrage](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=d2d3803a41&e=a2af77507c) for many reasons, not least of which is the blatant injustice to a true patriot—and innocent man—and to real victims of sexual assault.

The ongoing [lawfare](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=45e9407389&e=a2af77507c) to destroy the reputation, person, and candidacy of President Trump demonstrates what we are up against, and why we must win resoundingly this year, not only for the presidency, but also at all levels of local, state, and federal government. _**Local elections are the most important guardians to our freedom.**_ Our model is to strengthen counties with the Good Neighbor Program. In the past, we have lacked a sufficient ground game.

We are also partnering with Turning Point Action to implement a robust ballot chasing program. Remember, ballot harvesting is illegal in Michigan. Though I am no fan of mail-in voting except for the elderly, handicapped, military, and individuals who cannot vote in person, we must win at ballot chasing especially for low propensity voters. Many people, unfortunately, lack the political will to ensure they vote in person, so we must ensure those individuals cast their ballots for all Republican candidates. If we don’t, those low propensity voters will vote Democrat and we can’t have that.

Much is at stake.

Please [join](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=747b760a4c&e=a2af77507c) me and the real Michigan Republican Party as we fight for systemic election reform in Michigan and, through our [Good Neighbor Program](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=1ba9d8c8df&e=a2af77507c), find, recruit, and elect America First candidates to office.

In Liberty,
Kristina Karamo
Chairwoman
Michigan Republican Party

[Michigan Supports Karamo](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=a55f45fdd8&e=a2af77507c)
[VIDEO: Calling All Delegates: Join the Resistance to Save the MIGOP](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=16b36d64ae&e=a2af77507c)
---
|
---
|
---
[Delegates](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=fc3391c2c3&e=a2af77507c) throughout the state will be selected at the February 15 county conventions to participate in the MIGOP District Convention on Saturday, March 2. **To get all the details you need to prepare for convention** , sign up at the [MIGOP Playbook](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=1ec7727a5c&e=a2af77507c), which also gives you access to the Good Neighbor Program!

For more information about upcoming events, visit the [MIGOP events page](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=2817fe11bb&e=a2af77507c).
|
---
|
---
The January 26 edition of _[Friday Lunch with Chair Karamo](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=859d2f514b&e=a2af77507c)_ is available on the MIGOP website. Topics discussed:
* What is going on with the MIGOP chair?
* County conventions: February 15, 2024
* District convention: March 2, 2024
* [Good Neighbor Program](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=f7657980f3&e=a2af77507c)

By Noon each Friday, a new interview with the Chairwoman will be posted. All previous interviews are also available.
* * *
**MIGOP Issues Committee Resolutions**
On January 13, 2024, the Michigan Republican State Central Committee adopted the following resolutions:

[Resolution to Stop the Prosecutions of Donald J. Trump](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=9aacde9f36&e=a2af77507c)
[Resolution to End the USA’s Financial and Military Involvement in the War in Ukraine](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=337eb5c47e&e=a2af77507c)
[Resolution Calling for an End to the US Taxpayer Subsidy of Dictator Ilham Aliyev and the Republic of Azerbaijan](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=6ce5c830ce&e=a2af77507c)
* * *
[Trucker Randy interviews Dan Bonamie, MIGOP Budget Committee chairman](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=fcdc40b691&e=a2af77507c)
* * *
[See photos as Detroit Lions drone light show lights up the sky](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=cf41e5e12b&e=a2af77507c)
|
---
|
---
**Royal Oak Recount Update**

On January 24, Plaintiff William Harrison’s attorney filed a 79-page response to the defendants’ motion for summary disposition. He is suing the Oakland County Board of Canvassers and the Clerk of Royal Oak for their refusal to investigate evidence of possible voter disenfranchisement discovered in a recount of Proposal B—ranked choice voting—in the November 7, 2023 Royal Oak election. More than a dozen voters have signed affidavits attesting to having voted, _**but their names are not listed in the city’s official, certified List of Voters**_. Inexplicably, the bipartisan Oakland County Board of Canvassers has, thus far, refused to investigate.
* * *
**Has Your Representative Signed the Election Integrity Pledge?**

The [Election Integrity pledge](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=613eb6648c&e=a2af77507c) is a resolution calling on candidates and election officials to do their part in helping clean up the voter rolls in time for the 2024 general election. Chairwoman Kristina Karamo and the founders of [Check My Vote](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=10fba32424&e=a2af77507c) were the first to sign. Call your representative. Ask them to sign the Pledge. If they won’t, ask WHY NOT?

**CORRECTION** to the January 22, 2024 e-newsletter regarding the CMV/MIGOP partnership update: a CMV team member has filed criminal charges, not the MIGOP.

name: Restore Our Nation
subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insights
body:
His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qBKdBkN8qQcZmBd_0HXe2w~~/AARclAA~~)
---
| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qBKdBkN8qQcZmBd_0HXe2w~~/AARclAA~~)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qBKdBkN8qQcZmBd_0HXe2w~~/AARclAA~~)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

## DOE Backs Off Strict Gas Stove Rules
The Biden administration released new regulations requiring stoves to be more efficient, but the rules are [significantly weaker ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O4yAURp8Gd1hwIf4pXGy0cpe0W1rYXOK7wmABCco8_ShTT_V90mmOzr_bcjPkKTzu5sCpuLiYrdALF8mV4KAX3djJIQKqBifZi64DrXpo9kmaYexV1w_gVrcOgwahYEW0mx57010amkCAFlIJKS4XGFoh1NhJbc0q5DiKlWmBlkpM7f9Ioezo_Du-MLVbPBo_7aWcmak_DGYGc621PXL4MAYzBv7MDOaA9TNn9FRo-9yVLAZ-PldPecfMqymY0HIba-APk3ku8YUcnaONMGxvnp4eGcwm8etV7unv171Jkz0reU-565kWj8OQ_7Eqvzb6DgAA__-PHmjp)than originally proposed, reflecting ongoing public and industry opposition. Initially, the Energy Department estimated the rules would force 50% of gas stoves to be upgraded. But the department now says that [97% of current gas stoves](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFupDAQgOGnMZ1X47ExR0FxDd1eeyUyMMAkxl7ZE1abp4-SOvVf_NL3_z7dA0dO-79w0iBbnsIifNFktAWNbnLNOmxESLahwXTgPTrbYXMMEGhut35xLXjy1kNnTeew3dpg_LpsDQ8I6MBYMNC2-OcGYHtv3BpmMH0Ps3JAK0sut7fMSQ7a4itfVG5LPps4HCKPquxfhaPCUQ46OMbvpnBM9KyRRKhUhSMlKvtLU7q45HRSEoWjc9ajMXrmlZIO68mJq5QgnJPeOIXIn1T1k8I7Fb2Hqqvki3T5iKRwbMqwPp4cI1ffKQf7Gfjn3sivTl8BAAD__2cuas4) and 77% of electric ones already meet the requirements. The issue became[ highly politicized,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFurDAQheGnMZ3ReOyFpXBxG7q9bUrkxQNMZGxkHAh5-ihJkSb1-Yqj_-UxPBwHjvN_t5ItUxrcWPigQUkNEs1gKm8nIiRdkVUtNA0a3WK12JtBNE3XdgA4tV63vlFovFHqOd6dx4otAhpQGhTcbnivAXTXKOPdE1TXwVMYIM8l5fo1cSwLTeFKB-V6TGsV7FLKtgv9T2AvsD_Psz7dvnCcS4r07laOP1Rgv6XA4yWwp0h5vqSLXlI8OKe4UiwCe7yj0QC_xNPmcvla5cTRBf6gXc5ul3tJB8n8FkhgX2Xrt5ND4L1phYF5dRy-_5U_a30GAAD__3KjbEc) with many Republicans and even some moderate Democrats saying the administration was going too far. The new rules were developed with industry stakeholders.
## IRS Leaker Gets 5 Years in Prison
A former IRS contractor was [sentenced to five years in prison](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGyoyAUgOGnwe44hyNqKCi2scu2WzoIR8NelAyQmLz9ndz61n_zzf_vOl9tiOHY_tqdTV3TbF0NT54ldAikZtV4szITdw0bOeIwkOpGam7G2u4y-p60HFbPiskt40AaqVfLqpmaYAhJoexQYt_TpUXs9CCVtwtKrXERCtmHmnL7P4Wj3niN7_Tk3Lq0N9Hcar0X0f0RNAmazvNsMz8q5_LpgqbIm42CJn5ByAVcOmq2rqYMhY_Kh2MPPbzZ5gKR7Vc4Nqj5sd-h2hdkdin7Ah8joATSgqYmG38_Q4yhDKNQuO02xB9O_XXOdwAAAP__0bFlhQ) Monday after being found guilty of releasing thousands of tax returns of wealthy Americans, including former President Trump. The contractor, Charles Littlejohn, issued a statement where he assumed sole responsibility for the leaks and described his motivation as transparency and a ["sincere misguided belief."](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O4yAURp8Gd9eCa_BP4WJTuFgp26a0CFxidjFYQOLN248y9VTfJ53m6Nyu61X74OPjj95pri6t2lT_olVAxwHlKhs7OyKkrqFZDLzvUXYDNts8KlIT50Io5SZEpyZELt1oOjloM7rGz8hRctFxwZXCseW8m3ohrb5zMU38ziQn62vK7d_kY93IhXd6UW5N2pswb7UehXW_GC4Ml_M8273ED2O4UIRnYbhEOj9zpOCrN5_rUt4pg88FTIrlGaqOFc4tQSD9jyzYFHWwUPNzPwpU_R8ymZRtAZv1WUDBm3SGQrFSNMRw0RkuF7Hl1-13k2d7nD4EX_qBSf7YtQ_fvvXHel8BAAD__20AciE) [Prosecutors alleged](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2P4yAUAH8N7rAeH4G4oLjGXa690gL8HBNhiOBdnP33q2y93UjTjObfbbn5lFO5__UHOtrq4iOlFy6CK-BSL3pY3YYoUQ3ohAVjpFZWDrub0G7Ghwt6tRkhA0RtAk52s9cQwZohOQlSg1Ag4HKR1xFATUbo1QcQ0wSBacA1UW3jo6ZCO275q76wjbEeQ3Y70bMz9YfJmcn5PM8xhl7w7B_P5PxBJmd889Q6j7VQ85Fq43H3LWPnORFlfNS9cGr_j2fn5N-8Yaxt7bxjISwRVybnobn1eaacUzeWabgfPuWfDPp1yncAAAD__5YEZaM) Littlejohn deliberately took a position with the IRS with the goal of accessing the financial records of Trump and other rich taxpayers and releasing them to the public.
## Police Rescue Circus Animals from Fire
Indiana state troopers who spotted a tractor-trailer engulfed in flames on Interstate 95 rescued five zebras, four camels, and a miniature horse from the burning truck before any were hurt. [Photos are here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAURL_GdBfZxkAoKF4K9JpsuyW62BfsXdtEtgnKfv0qqbea0UxzdD5v8w2dd3H7wEBjWfcZdXEPmgU0HKSaVWXGlUhSU9Eoet51UjW9rOzIW6350Esx8MugOlSyXcRgjBZL17dGV26UXCouGi5428pLzXkzdEIZXLgYBr4wxcm4sqf6a3exWFr9c39QqvUeKj_aUu6ZNf-YnJiczvOsQ46vj8mJIhyZySnS-Yp3_6ElYQaNgXwGjAZWj4Ey7BbCE7RL-njtLqDPkCjrgwzgWihBSYf-Bo1FW8qwukSwR3DROIwI1m32xCeTEya4XoUN7fa_SqO5n857l7ueKb4FdP6NXv4U-RsAAP__hJZ10Q) The animals all belonged to the Shrine Circus. While they were unharmed, several officers were treated for smoke inhalation. Additional officers arrived to help secure the animals. A Shrine Circus director said the animals were headed from [Florida to Fort Wayne for weekend performances](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2unDAQRp_GdIOMbf4KilwpdHfblGiAMZ7E2Cvbu2jz9NFuner7pNMcnV_fyzey53Dc8KSp2LjgVvhJSwNagjKLqfbJEinSFU1NL7tOGd2ryk1E2vY0KFqRzDa2asRd0dqa3upBD7biSUllZKNlI9tWDbWUeuwas-Mqm3GUqzCSdi4x1b8jh-LI-ld8Uqq3eFZ-cqXcs9A_hJqFmq_rqs8c3kyomQI8slBzoOs9n89hZwwI0VreKGXI-CT4S2vCDBue5DNg2AHBxZQJVvIxHBwOKBE2Ttsjg03xhMT5zwscH-7CF1hOJNSMCb6-Gpdu7meVpv1-sfecu14YeZzI_iNd_pvwXwAAAP__9EB0zQ) when the truck caught fire. Another truck arrived to ensure the animals didn't miss their show.

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. | **
### What students are saying
** “I appreciate the brevity of explanation and new information in a way I hadn't known or realized myself. The quizzes are helpful. Having two teachers converse brings an interesting perspective.” **- Darlena** “It helps put into context the thinking of our founders at that time. That’s very important and misunderstood by so many people today!” **- Robert**
---|---

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

The struggle is real
Are things working for the working class? These are the stories of the people in my district, the "missing middle". They are tough, resilient rural families who value hard work, grit, and tenacity.
Yet, careless representation in Washington — representation that isn't from here — often leaves them all flown-over and forgotten.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
You can help our campaign get to work for people like Sara, Mitchell, Martha and Cris. Working class voices deserve to be heard. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
RUSH $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=express_lane_10]

RUSH $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=express_lane_50]
Friend,
Many working households in Michigan's 1st District have the same story; they don't make enough to get by, but they supposedly make "too much" to catch a break.
As I travel throughout the District, I hear from constituents like:

These folks are working, and working hard. Many times, they work more than one job. I grew up in a lower-middle-class home. Because of investments in working families, my five siblings and I never experienced significant hardship.
But, times have changed.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
To make life more affordable for everyone, yes, we must work to bring down costs, but our Congressperson must also serve everyday people with investments in childcare, healthcare, housing, and education.
We need family-sustaining wages, Medicare for All, and union protections.
We must increase the supply of affordable housing, offer energy tax credits, provide public pre-K, and give tax cuts to small businesses.
That is my platform.
That's why I'm running.
Friend, if you can afford to chip in, I'm asking you to stand in our corner as we fight [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] to ensure that the working class is never forgotten ever again.
— Dr. Bob
