body:
I'd like to invite you to join me in Hillsdale College's newest free course studying the greatest Christian apologist of the 20th century, C.S. Lewis.

| | |
---
| | | | This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82a3037182814e9a8388744d00386700&_e=B8d7rX5hWgo2aw1_aycUY8Lmuv7OwQJ1c34nzFLgKVON5vEOMGDQ4fpermwuzOL98AMG9D2HlhA2SgWhB0KZ_4icKuuRODRGi0Le09reQH8bDrHb9mHQxopiEH1NeuRHKUXRxirOFHuUXbAH_xqGzM2CqC_hkjbQCM6YZNjx4bJl6FYwORv_BfqDUB-a0CugccD67xkUqeY6EF851Ptwmzs_FqI-wR67f_EvhRoKw1JlhpTVCukmJGBanhNb8Wf_reVCWg6kavD0yl7XsdM9-ZOo1lhWveHDJlQiRC_jeh4JkP93mE-dU_Hiho9rbos_g-P-cNqdZSg21yqRFcla8L_axPdRFM708TttgIF7JdQZpecPeBgxo4Gqq1gS3k0Rjve7tticoq1yJtMT9IGkzyniDMbNt70VnL7qiwFHztSI_eWf8AeMjvQ7FUl9CqFp) [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82a3037182814e9a8388744d00386700&_e=B8d7rX5hWgo2aw1_aycUY8Lmuv7OwQJ1c34nzFLgKVON5vEOMGDQ4fpermwuzOL98AMG9D2HlhA2SgWhB0KZ_4icKuuRODRGi0Le09reQH8bDrHb9mHQxopiEH1NeuRHKUXRxirOFHuUXbAH_xqGzM2CqC_hkjbQCM6YZNjx4bJl6FYwORv_BfqDUB-a0CugccD67xkUqeY6EF851Ptwmzs_FqI-wR67f_EvhRoKw1JlhpTVCukmJGBanhNb8Wf_reVCWg6kavD0yl7XsdM9-aaJ-vD5qbc4ObtIbmbMVPlySZ43LV4VKxawTdMeL7ODDZq56JWX8wyuILin1-wCIB-nUTYhDb-PZpazNhy_YOjgK_EADQ7phsCE-2THZnEhkGRg9fVCoJhZjxUBtQ6zmOS0PFnsinE_OWHSZbuArdEh3oAKXPrYKeJvST8hKA4P) | Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That’s why we’re so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale’s Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. | **
### What students are saying
** “I appreciate the brevity of explanation and new information in a way I hadn’t known or realized myself. The quizzes are helpful. Having two teachers converse brings an interesting perspective.” **- Darlena** “It helps put into context the thinking of our founders at that time. That’s very important and misunderstood by so many people today!” **- Robert**
---|---

As Dr. West explains, the Founders’ political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a “deep and long-forgotten pit.”

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That’s why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **“The Real American Founding: A Conversation,”** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82a3037182814e9a8388744d00386700&_e=B8d7rX5hWgo2aw1_aycUY8Lmuv7OwQJ1c34nzFLgKVON5vEOMGDQ4fpermwuzOL98AMG9D2HlhA2SgWhB0KZ_4icKuuRODRGi0Le09reQH8bDrHb9mHQxopiEH1NeuRHKUXRxirOFHuUXbAH_xqGzM2CqC_hkjbQCM6YZNjx4bJl6FYwORv_BfqDUB-a0CugccD67xkUqeY6EF851Ptwmzs_FqI-wR67f_EvhRoKw1JlhpTVCukmJGBanhNb8Wf_reVCWg6kavD0yl7XsdM9-Ux-mIWkWevAs3AHdypfwVD2abP0gf_dmkwy-VW8jHodmUSNVBSMvFLpgI8W0TpETe7Z5BKtQPyNpo6G-usoDwUvKsz0qCSfmt2BJZiNB4r9nYvwbka5wWQGKwCvxkJ4lhhHkkmempEcggRH1Am-leSIaUFfyqbpRJpfz2jYagJZ)

I hope you’ll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

That’s very important and misunderstood by so many people today!” - Robert ---|--- As Dr. West explains, the Founders’ political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a “deep and long-forgotten pit.” This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America. The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it. As you know, our online courses are free. That’s why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible. Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course? And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for “The Real American Founding: A Conversation,” by clicking the link below. I hope you’ll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans. Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College | | Hillsdale College 33 East College St Hillsdale, MI 49242 USA Freedom Nation Today 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314 | _

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: Learn about the real American Founding
body:
I'd like to invite you to join me in Hillsdale College's newest free course studying the greatest Christian apologist of the 20th century, C.S. Lewis.

| | |
---
| | | | This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=984c3856991c4928b937a44280cd2e48&_e=qN4urRT3munK1oDZUEk7GPle4yRl7DLdsCXkqLEwGy5PFjpH7A3V3Vsj1R9ketrqJaI-IuraZPnR8XxIICGMpxzDXkExteszAJykcumxaMm5oKt6mjVBDZsyUJN--JxyO7zVS7FCUzUmNJ4WvMVCgUfjC-y7IQ9LWSFLNxdy-7lUkbPzImTOVhzdrmsAYJcunS6mldcJzZgrzZz_lrx85vIFn_Rz66r3cLLc2A8uVfM7PFo0EKKkj2J0pOUlZtHhyxz41NUughN7jZkW2H2XYTCEzG3g-hlNop3f-3NiJ7xPYG2viEYo_334SjWTQ_6gzw9arGuskewi2WvIqkqLK_qi778whoPri08B-UwnDzhZNX9ShuJbnnI-PKqIpuID5HbDlzCvLChIQZQTuzchuhcTV-aHUz5yXBz-n3zxMXAnDTjgl-kkeAUu1-_yQMHA) [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=984c3856991c4928b937a44280cd2e48&_e=qN4urRT3munK1oDZUEk7GPle4yRl7DLdsCXkqLEwGy5PFjpH7A3V3Vsj1R9ketrqJaI-IuraZPnR8XxIICGMpxzDXkExteszAJykcumxaMm5oKt6mjVBDZsyUJN--JxyO7zVS7FCUzUmNJ4WvMVCgUfjC-y7IQ9LWSFLNxdy-7lUkbPzImTOVhzdrmsAYJcunS6mldcJzZgrzZz_lrx85vIFn_Rz66r3cLLc2A8uVfM7PFo0EKKkj2J0pOUlZtHhyxz41NUughN7jZkW2H2XYUMI3fHyelMB71VLNyk-sDBOfwxysnlcmoT6YDEwM6AxUk0be7an2Z8Pz5n0Fm2BhYHMVUiEBLFdrv6FcLXCW5FxN72-dQtLz4i03de1ggsMx2U8lvdmsRGseJ0FE3HH1y7cEseJryY85JylkCVoxCZc-7O2u69_sa7Xjht53iSw) | Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. | **
### What students are saying
** “I appreciate the brevity of explanation and new information in a way I hadn't known or realized myself. The quizzes are helpful. Having two teachers converse brings an interesting perspective.” **- Darlena** “It helps put into context the thinking of our founders at that time. That’s very important and misunderstood by so many people today!” **- Robert**
---|---

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=984c3856991c4928b937a44280cd2e48&_e=qN4urRT3munK1oDZUEk7GPle4yRl7DLdsCXkqLEwGy5PFjpH7A3V3Vsj1R9ketrqJaI-IuraZPnR8XxIICGMpxzDXkExteszAJykcumxaMm5oKt6mjVBDZsyUJN--JxyO7zVS7FCUzUmNJ4WvMVCgUfjC-y7IQ9LWSFLNxdy-7lUkbPzImTOVhzdrmsAYJcunS6mldcJzZgrzZz_lrx85vIFn_Rz66r3cLLc2A8uVfM7PFo0EKKkj2J0pOUlZtHhyxz41NUughN7jZkW2H2XYaP2Rm2GSDKpy2TYehQluS57VXUzR_l47WpkVW6ugFWqWLi3z86NiHIYdfhVOWJMUDc76XXo3lQUd2gtETsUrIuDxYnoyyeIEWXaVFy2ltwIIB4fuInk7mPZM7uAzQ93Dx12nwidIfRcsqYARJwAiWGpEmRlMvwEvGl60FF_2LUi)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

Lewis. | | | | | | | This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College | Hello Friend, Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding. That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, which is now available on DVD. In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. | What students are saying “I appreciate the brevity of explanation and new information in a way I hadn't known or realized myself. The quizzes are helpful. Having two teachers converse brings an interesting perspective.” - Darlena “It helps put into context the thinking of our founders at that time. That’s very important and misunderstood by so many people today!” - Robert ---|--- As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit." This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America. The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it. As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible. | | |

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. | **
### What students are saying
** “I appreciate the brevity of explanation and new information in a way I hadn't known or realized myself. The quizzes are helpful. Having two teachers converse brings an interesting perspective.” **- Darlena** “It helps put into context the thinking of our founders at that time. That’s very important and misunderstood by so many people today!” **- Robert**
---|---

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4427a30971994ccea6492a593b5e133d&_e=sjZPNbRYsurfpQ7VsTECwZy4maIhG2mDR4e8wzj1Qn3lsFUSFUrcnnOrYE9BQYcUDVt40ZZu8JMvstPg281nJi_z5ePXTjJkadFbsK636AGSCOD6W0LiIm7Ymxs7Mf7yQFNIQkDZ_VCn6-tJpVUNZCMBvUAI92fl7YWxAt3qeIiHzOsiILb8cplQj1SSLN1VRQYMPM0UEvkaC4c43sU3KX5TLCcHHd7HQ7lwdzBwgjAiC8nLKgzJyiGMhgZs7wczHFjav0m8BbskRh493JuPQdZPm9lUzGF8PgXYOgXUuzU5GC01h-O6RWHFNMq2XV9fEH1Lu96rGPCSjYr99F8g82qF3TPmXRiYBJkA0-ecH7QleVryppOGvyWeYwjML9gbNXog9L3tYPcNzXBl4OtcmqOn1qqZmXTbRRojtHOuM7XywWTPRD0mjdDsp_SGlIFT)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

name: Shift WA
subject: FACTS
body:
Here's a chilling fact that provides the starkest contrast
between Republicans and the current majority.

Friends,

Washington Democrats have crossed
a line that we cannot ignore.

In a shocking move, Washington
Democrats introduced House Bill 2030, which would grant felons in
prison - including notorious serial killer Gary Ridgway - the
right to vote and serve on a jury. We are not making this up -
the bill's Far-Left sponsor admitted her criminals-first approach
would extend even to the Green River Killer.

And this is just one of the many
outrageous and out-of-touch bills Democrat legislators have
brought forward in the first month of the 2024 legislative
session.

This week, State House Democrats
passed House Bill 1589 as their next step in banning natural gas
in our state. If this bill passes the Senate, it would prohibit
gas companies, particularly Puget Sound Energy (PSE), from
connecting new natural gas lines to new construction. PSE would
also no longer be obligated to provide natural gas service to
existing customers. This is an unprecedented intrusion into our
everyday lives.

But perhaps most egregiously,
Democrats seem to have adopted a mantra during this legislative
session - "If you can't let them vote, then just let them out."
Since their goal of allowing serial killers to vote may be
slipping away, they've also introduced House Bill 2001, which
would mean sentence reductions for current prisoners, by ignoring
previous criminal activity that liberals no longer consider
criminal.

It's not too late to voice your
opposition to these bills. The first legislative deadline is
approaching on January 31st, and your support can help ensure
that bills like these are stopped. You can voice your opposition
by officially commenting against these bills here: HB2030,
HB1589, and HB2001.

Shift WA is the only online
outlet you can trust to bring you the latest news from Olympia,
exposing Democrats for their terrible policies. We are committed
to keeping you informed and empowered.

To continue our efforts, we need
your support. Please consider making a donation today. Every
contribution helps us fight against these outrageous bills and
hold our elected officials accountable.

Thank you,

The Shift WA Team

P.S. Your donation is crucial in
the fight against these out-of-touch bills. Please contribute
today to support our cause.

DONATE

Washington. If you would like to send this message to some of
your friends, you can click here to do so.

You can also stay up to date on
our efforts to shift the debate in Washington State by following
us on Facebook & Twitter.

in error or no longer wish to receive emails from Shift
Washington, click to unsubscribe.

body:
Hello,

I hope this email finds you well and that your 2024 is off to a good start. You are receiving this email because you opted into my email updates since I ran for Congress in 2022 or my 2024 campaign and I really appreciate your interest and support.

Last cycle, we may not have won the nomination and the U.S. House seat, but we made history in the United States of America. Our campaign was called crazy, and we didn't receive the backing and support we thought we would.

However, I was honored to become the youngest person in modern American history to run for the U.S. Congress and to have received votes in a federal election. 1064 people here in the 23rd Congressional District of Florida in the Democratic Primary in 2022 believed in our vision and the future of America. And for that I am forever grateful for.

**_Now, it is time for us to pick up where we left off and to make history again. I'm excited to inform you that I am seeking the Democratic nomination to become the next Florida State Representative for Florida's 91st House District serving Boca Raton, West Boca, and Highland Beach.
_**
This seat is currently held by an incumbent Republican and the demographics of our district are so evenly split (R+1 or R+2) that we can win this thing. I get along with everyone and I am a great networker.

We can do this, but we need your support. I anticipate more people in my circles in business and politics to support our campaign.

[**I'm honored that our first semi-endorsement occurred with my business partner and one of my mentors I look up to, Mr. Grant Cardone, sharing us on his Instagram following.**](https://youtube.com/shorts/KPuTIHkMG_o?feature=share)

I have been a part of the 10X movement since I was in college in 2019, and it was like I met my tribe one could say. I have a big vision and dream and it is an honor to be a business partner with Mr. Cardone also. I'm a limited partner with Cardone Capital in his 10X Las Olas Walk property in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.

Please pledge a donation, sign up to volunteer and let's make sure that the whole district, state and nation knows that Gen Z is here and ready to lead. Let's Progress and 10X HD 91!

Sincerely Yours,

Michaelangelo Collins Hamilton
Democratic Candidate for Florida State Representative, District 91

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. | **
### What students are saying
** “I appreciate the brevity of explanation and new information in a way I hadn't known or realized myself. The quizzes are helpful. Having two teachers converse brings an interesting perspective.” **- Darlena** “It helps put into context the thinking of our founders at that time. That’s very important and misunderstood by so many people today!” **- Robert**
---|---

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

subject: Tilting the scales
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| Tammy Baldwin asked me to reach out.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=1897%2E35263%2EfFr2v_)
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jan24.HgOSTk&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20240130_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=1897%2E35263%2EfFr2v_) Hi Peter — Ben Wikler here from the Democratic Party of Wisconsin. Wisconsin is home to some of the _most competitive_ elections in the country — and Tammy Baldwin’s reelection race this year is shaping up to be no different. **Last month, Senate Republicans threw their support behind Eric Hovde** , the right-wing megamillionaire who is gearing up to enter Wisconsin’s Senate race. Last week, on the 51st anniversary of _Roe v. Wade_ , I helped introduce legislation in Congress to protect abortion access in Virginia and support providers.

Virginia remains the only southern state in the country that hasn’t restricted access to abortion following the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ in June 2022.

As a result, many individuals from surrounding states have had to turn to Virginia and other states where abortion is still legal to seek reproductive healthcare. As Governor, I’ll continue to protect our fundamental rights.

body:
Whether it’s gold bars, intimidating college students to hold off endorsements, attacking opponents, or putting one’s thumb on the scale with a rigged ballot, it’s time to stand up against corruption.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78023962/452185272/41798106?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMGI1YjBlZC03YmJmLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PCjDJ1-mK-ksM7GN6ECk4Og2E8ms6EnE3cIAmoJfcP4=&emci=aeb30ea3-cdbe-ee11-b660-002248223197&emdi=e0b5b0ed-7bbf-ee11-b660-002248223197&ceid=26261389)
---

| | Whether it's gold bars, intimidating college students to hold off endorsements, attacking opponents, or putting one's thumb on the scale with a rigged ballot, it's time to stand up against corruption. **I know for some, New Jersey politics —**** _and politics in general_****— has a reputation for corruption.** Many people and politicians brush it off, saying _that's just Jersey_. But, when we say that corruption "comes with the job," people lose faith in our democracy. They begin to think that if it's all corrupt, why should they even bother? **You've heard me say before that I believe that the opposite of democracy is apathy.** We are losing more and more people to it while we allow corruption to remain. _But that's why I'm in this fight._ **I've fought against corruption** – from big corporate money to Donald Trump's attempts to steal an election – and when I saw that Senator Menendez betrayed the public's trust, I knew I had to take that fight to the Senate. But if corruption exists anywhere, it can thrive everywhere. I am in this race to restore integrity back into our politics, show people that there are public servants that are trying to do the right work, and put the people ahead of personal gain or ambition and just be able to deliver for my state – **and all I'm asking for as a candidate for the United States Senate is that we give the people a real choice and a fair shot at representation that works for them.** We're working hard to win this election, even with the reality of the wealthy and well-connected working against us. **But the truth is it's going to take a lot of resources to keep our strong momentum going to primary day.** We need to show voters that a vote for our campaign is a vote to restore trust in government and strengthen our democracy, root out corruption through major ethics reform, get dark money out of politics through campaign finance reform, and empower voters to elect the candidate of _their_ choice rather than political bosses selecting it _for them_. body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12676438?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My fellow Floridians,

We had another productive week in Tallahassee! Last week, it was great to meet with constituents, stakeholders, and fellow elected officials to discuss how we can build a better future for Florida. As State Representative, I promise to put the good people of District 24 first, and I am committed to ensuring that your voice is heard. I truly appreciate your continued trust and support!

Thank you for reading this recap of some of the great things that happened in Tallahassee. I look forward to keeping you updated on my work in the Florida House.
---
|
---
| | | | | | [](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=41e1977798&e=d1c1b9864f) | [Follow Rep. Chamberlin on Facebook](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=d83cb8a57f&e=d1c1b9864f)
---|---
| | **Legislation Highlight: H.B. 1 - Social Media Use for Minors**
---
|
---
| I am proud to Co-Sponsor **[HB 1 - Social Media Use for Minors](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=4d901c50fb&e=d1c1b9864f)**. On Wednesday, January 24th, HB 1, a bill by Representatives Sirois, McFarland, and Rayner, passed in the house with 106 yeas. The time is now for us to stop Big Tech and Social Media from targeting our children. They have been intentional and have chosen not to alter their methods. Enough is enough. The Florida House has now answered and will lead the nation in protecting the future generation. This bill will protect kids from the harmful impacts of social media by prohibiting minors from creating new accounts. This bill will also have social media platforms terminate accounts that are held by minors by using age verification methods. We are now looking forward for it to be passed by the Senate and ultimately implemented in our States Laws. Thank you to Representative Sirois and Representative McFarland for working so hard to ensure this bill is passed. HB 1 is going to accomplish so much by keeping our minors protected.

If you have any questions on this bill, [please reach out to my office](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=a3fe079599&e=d1c1b9864f).
---
| | **Monday, January 22**
---
|
---
| I had the pleasure of meeting with members of the Florida Association of School Administrators (FASA) from Walton and Okaloosa counties to discuss priorities within education. Thank you for your mission to support and empower administrators in providing high-quality education to all students in Florida.
---
| | **Tuesday, January 23**
---
|
---
| |
---
Tuesday morning, I attended the Ringing of the Bells to honor fallen firefighters. Thank you to all of our first responders for your daily sacrifice. Our hearts go out to the families of those who paid the ultimate price.
---
|
---
| I had the pleasure of meeting with Dr. James Henningsen, President of the College of Central Florida, and members of the Board of Trustees at the Capitol this week to discuss appropriations and ongoing projects at Central Florida.
---
|
---
| It was a privilege to meet with Kevin Sheilley, CEO & President of Ocala/Marion County Chamber & Economic Partnership, and his team to discuss community involvement and appropriation projects. It is always an honor to welcome fellow Marion County residents and public servants to my office in Tallahassee.
---
|
---
| It was Space Day at the Capitol this week, and it was great to meet with many industry professionals. We discussed ongoing projects and legislative priorities that directly affect the space industry and ensure that Florida remains at the forefront of the nation’s space program.

Florida Space Day is a milestone event that presents an opportunity to educate and bring awareness to Florida legislators on the significance of the aerospace industry and its impact on Florida’s economy.
---
|
---
| This week I had a productive meeting with Tri-Eagle Sales, the Anheuser-Busch beer distributor, to discuss the current bills that have a direct impact on their industry, as well as future legislation of importance.
---
|
---
| I also met with Second Harvest of Central Florida, an organization that is dedicated to helping feed the hungry. They have been in Marion County for almost two years and are continuing to grow and be a resource for our community. I am grateful for their vision to inspire and engage our community to end hunger and help our neighbors thrive.
---
| | **Wednesday, January 24**
---
|
---
| Wednesday morning, Representative Chuck Clemons invited Pastor Rocky McKinley to open Session in prayer. It was an honor to welcome Pastor McKinley, a personal friend, to the Capital City. I am grateful for his years of ministry and leadership in Florida.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| On Wednesday morning, I had the privilege of meeting with the newly elected Mayor of Ocala, Ben Marciano, as well as the leadership of the City of Ocala on the House floor. They had a tour of the chamber and later discussed ongoing appropriations and legislative projects.
---
|
---
| I had the pleasure of meeting with the leadership of Arnette House, which is based in Marion County, and we spent time discussing all of the phenomenal work their organization is doing. Arnette House's mission is to provide safe and effective programs to strengthen youth and families. I am thankful for their dedicated professionals who focus on the family’s strengths while providing skills and knowledge to help improve life at home.
---
|
---
| State Attorney Bill Gladson visited our office this week. We discussed ongoing projects and explored ways in which our office can support his team.
---
|
---
| Leadership from the Marion County Public Library System visited our office this week while they were in Tallahassee. We had a very productive meeting discussing their legislative priorities and the resources their office provides. I am thankful for their dedication to providing the best possible library service to the community.
---
|
---
---
|
---
| Wednesday afternoon I met with Board Members from the American Fire Sprinkler Association. AFSA educates and trains workers in the industry while promoting fire protection systems to save lives and property. It was great to learn more about their association, and we discussed future projects and apprenticeship programs to show that their industry is valuable in the workforce.
---
|
---
| Following Session, my wife Jenny and I attended the Rural Counties Day Legislative Reception hosted by Representative Bobby Payne.
---
| | **Week 3: Committee Meetings**
---
| We made a lot of progress during committee meetings last week. It is an honor to play such a significant role in the future of our state, and I look forward to seeing many of our bills succeed on the House floor in the upcoming weeks.

I met with the following committees during the week:
* Select Committee on Health Innovation
* Judiciary Committee
* Regulatory Reform & Economic Development Subcommittee
* Civil Justice Subcommittee
* Education Quality Subcommittee
* State Administration & Technology Appropriations Subcommittee

During the Education Quality Subcommittee, I debated [HB 931](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=9339a0fff0&e=d1c1b9864f), sponsored by Representative McClain. HB 931 would authorize school districts and charter schools to adopt policies to allow volunteer school chaplains. I appreciate the hard work Representative McClain has put into HB 931 and I look forward to the progress this bill will make in the coming weeks.
---
|
---
|
---
| | I am working hard for you and your family in Tallahassee! Thank you for electing me to serve you. It is the highest honor to represent you in the Florida Legislature.

I look forward to keeping you updated on my work during the 2024 Legislative Session. As always, if I may be of any assistance, please do not hesitate to contact my office by **[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=f80000fd1f&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.myfloridahouse.gov/Sections/Representatives/contactmember.aspx?MemberId=4901&SessionId=103&utm_source=Ryan+Chamberlin+for+State+Representative&utm_campaign=ae0a433299-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_08_05_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7ddd94a0de-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D")**.

**Ryan Chamberlin**

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1080%2E135344%2Eu1j3yx)

Friends -
It's the end of January, and that means if you're anything like me you're seeing non-stop requests for money from political campaigns and organizations. And as you have likely seen, there are some striking similarities in these emails and the tactics they use:
There's the 3x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-jan24.--Kpen&refcode=em240130-1-350&t=2&akid=1080%2E135344%2Eu1j3yx)
The 5x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-jan24.--Kpen&refcode=em240130-1-350&t=3&akid=1080%2E135344%2Eu1j3yx)
And even the 10x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-jan24.--Kpen&refcode=em240130-1-350&t=4&akid=1080%2E135344%2Eu1j3yx)
Here's the thing: none of that is real. No one is matching donations. They are trying to trick people into donating. It's cynical, and it's something we're never going to do here.

Petition Season & Giving Back to the Community | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/32c7ab816428/rob-for-pa-weekly-update?e=131e83a3c2)
---
Dear friend,
Last week we kicked off the petition season at Grotto Pizza in Wilkes-Barre! We had a great turnout and it set the stage for a strong showing on our petitions. After our kickoff, Rob and the campaign attended many petition signing events throughout Northeastern Pennsylvania. Although we’re off to a strong start, we need still need YOUR help. Please reach out to [Frank](mailto:frank@robforpa.com?subject=Petitions&body=) to start circulating a petition to get Rob on the ballot!
[](https://robforpa.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4aaa9665caa590d8638bb435d&id=f80469a19d&e=131e83a3c2)
|
---
Thank you to State Representatives Mike Cabell and Dane Watro, along with State Senator Lynda Culver for hosting petition parties in the Greater Hazleton Area and inviting us to collect signatures. We know that Republicans need to be elected up and down the ballot for a government that works for all Northeastern Pennsylvanians.
|
---
Rob also attended (as a spectator this time) the Northeast Polar Plunge, which benefits the Special Olympics Pennsylvania, on Saturday. Funds raised from this event go toward training and competitions in Olympic-style sports for adults and children with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Organizations like this are the backbone of Northeastern Pennsylvania.
|
---

We will need YOUR help to get Rob on the ballot throughout the rest of the petition period. Please feel free to reach out to our Political Director Frank Wojtash at (570)793-1487 or at frank@robforpa.com to start circulating and officially join Team Rob! Thank you for all your support!
Best Regards,Team Rob

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. |
### What students are saying
"I appreciate the brevity of explanation and new information in a way I hadn't known or realized myself. The quizzes are helpful. Having two teachers converse brings an interesting perspective." **- Darlena** "It helps put into context the thinking of our founders at that time. That's very important and misunderstood by so many people today!" **- Robert**
---|---

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

Derek, Adam
has spent years leading some of the most important fights to defend our
democracy — but there’s a lot that you may not know about him:

* Adam led the nation’s first prosecution of an FBI agent of espionage
as an Assistant U.S. Attorney — and learned important lessons that he
would later apply to another American the Russians would target for
his greed and proclivity for extramarital affairs.
* Adam prosecuted toxic waste dumpers and it led to the creation of the
first federal environmental crimes unit in Los Angeles — setting an
important precedent that no company, big or small, could harm people
or our planet and get away with it.
* Adam joined the U.S. Forest Service as a seasonal firefighter in the
early 1980s — and he’s made fire safety a legislative priority ever
since.
* Adam flipped a Republican seat blue in the most expensive
congressional race in history at the time — becoming the first
Democrat to represent his community since Franklin Roosevelt was
President.
* Adam served as Chair of the House Intelligence Committee and as the
lead impeachment manager in Trump’s Senate trial before serving on the
January 6 Committee — and then last year, Kevin McCarthy removed him
from the Intel Committee and Republicans censured him as political
payback and under threat from Donald Trump.

Adam’s experience and the results he’s delivered are about so much more
than standing up to Trump and the MAGA movement — but he hasn’t shied away
from the challenge of defending our democracy when he’s been called upon.

Right now, we're just one day away from our first end-of-month fundraising

will mistakenly think this ruling means the fight is won.

Nothing

beginning!

of Americans (regardless of how they vote) do NOT agree that
abortion should be unrestricted.

We must
stand together to defend a culture of life across America. If we
don't act now, I'm afraid that radicalized idealogues will
continue to seize positions of power and abuse their authority to
advance an anti-life agenda that is bent on the destruction of
the American family.

subject: Mario in the media and Volunteers needed for petitions
body:
Dear Friends and Supporters of Mario,

2024 has started off strong as Mario continues to meet with constituents across NY-24. Support grows and enthusiasm builds as voters learn about a candidate who brings true conservative values and conviction to face today's challenges and represent us in Washington, D.C.

SOCIAL MEDIA
Be sure to follow Mario on Facebook facebook.com/MarioForCongress<https://www.facebook.com/MarioForCongress> or @MarioFratto on X for regular updates from Mario on current issues that relate to our District.
Follow and share with others to spread the word!

MARIO IN THE MEDIA THIS WEEK
Catch Mario for several interviews this coming week.
Check out SAVE NY on Facebook this Wednesday, January 31, at 6:30pm for a time of interactive Q&A.
Also in Watertown, listen to Mario on Glenn Curry, 1240 AM WATN, Thursday, February 1 at 5:15pm here:
https://cbwatertown.com/watn/listen-live/

ALMOST PETITION TIME: VOLUNTEERS NEEDED!
It's almost petition time! Hundreds of signatures are needed to be on the ballot for Congress, and we need your help to collect them!
Starting February 27th, we need all hands on deck to get the required signatures.
Would you commit to helping get petition signatures and assure voters in NY-24 are able to send Mario Fratto to Congress for our district?
Reply to this email or sign up to volunteer at www.MarioforCongress.com<http://www.marioforcongress.com/>.

This year let's send Mario Fratto to Congress for District 24 in 2024!

www.MarioforCongress.com<http://www.marioforcongress.com/>

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

Surviving on Credit | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b4589296da70/conforti-for-congress-8395340?e=25f4fa3311)
---
| | |
---
| | | Dear Peter,

For many, it is getting harder and harder to stay afloat.

Inflation continues to keep prices high across the board. Grocery prices are high. Gas prices are high. And our taxes are going up. In some cases, families are having to choose between putting food on the table or paying a gas bill.

As a result, more and more Americans are turning to their credit cards just to get by. Overall consumer credit card debt is reaching record highs - and people are not paying off their debt -- or more likely, they are unable to do so. In a 2023 credit card debt survey by Bankrate, results showed that 49% of those surveyed are keeping balances on their cards, up from 39% in 2021. That is a 10% jump in just 2 years!!

Read the article [here](https://conforti4congress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fd34b7284bf7f5e87a4e45e5&id=b9b52176e9&e=25f4fa3311).

Casten is working against the people of the 6th Congressional District - and against all Americans. He has repeatedly voted against policies that will bring down high prices, continuing to hurt the American people.

Once I am in Congress, I will work to bring down high prices and help the people of the 6th District - not hurt them. It is time to remove the radical Casten and protect Americans.

Stay Safe! Stay Strong!

Can you help support the Conforti for Congress campaign's efforts to beat Casten? Your contribution will go a long way in helping us win! You can click the link below to make a donation today.

[](https://conforti4congress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fd34b7284bf7f5e87a4e45e5&id=5a9385082c&e=25f4fa3311)

Your support is greatly appreciated.
---
| Thank you,

Niki Conforti
Candidate
Illinois 6th Congressional District

clean_body: Surviving on Credit | | | | | | | | | | Dear Peter, For many, it is getting harder and harder to stay afloat. Inflation continues to keep prices high across the board. Grocery prices are high. Gas prices are high. And our taxes are going up. In some cases, families are having to choose between putting food on the table or paying a gas bill. As a result, more and more Americans are turning to their credit cards just to get by. Overall consumer credit card debt is reaching record highs - and people are not paying off their debt -- or more likely, they are unable to do so. In a 2023 credit card debt survey by Bankrate, results showed that 49% of those surveyed are keeping balances on their cards, up from 39% in 2021. That is a 10% jump in just 2 years!! Read the article . Casten is working against the people of the 6th Congressional District - and against all Americans. He has repeatedly voted against policies that will bring down high prices, continuing to hurt the American people. Once I am in Congress, I will work to bring down high prices and help the people of the 6th District - not hurt them. It is time to remove the radical Casten and protect Americans. Stay Safe! Stay Strong! Can you help support the Conforti for Congress campaign's efforts to beat Casten? Your contribution will go a long way in helping us win! You can click the link below to make a donation today. Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

body:
If we lose in Arizona we will lose our Senate majority.
#

Hey Peter,
I need to ask you to make a donation to my campaign before our first end-of-month deadline of the year hits tomorrow night.
I’ve been trying to figure out the best way to convince you to make that donation. Here’s what I know to be true:
_**If we lose in Arizona we will lose our Senate majority.**_
That’s not up for debate — it’s a fact. We have zero margin for error. Kari Lake lost her last election by about 17,000 votes. To put that into context, that’s less than a third as many people who attended the Super Bowl last year.

Team Slotkin has a bit of an unofficial motto: Low ego, no drama, just get stuff done. (OK, sometimes we use a different word for "stuff.").

When most people think about politics and the House of Representatives, those aren't exactly the words that come to mind.

And it’s true. There are a lot of egos in politics (trust me on that!), and a ton of drama that can prevent us from focusing on the work and getting stuff done. It helps that I didn't start my career as a politician, or with any aspiration to run for office. I spent decades in public service, from the CIA to the White House to the Pentagon. I served three tours overseas alongside our military. And especially when you’re serving in a warzone, it doesn't matter what political party you come from. What matters is whether you're focused on the mission at hand.

I've long believed that public service is the greatest love letter you can send to your country. When 9/11 happened, I started working in national security because I believed it was the best way I could serve my country. Years later, I ran for office for the very same reason.

There's a lot of cynicism about politics, and it's easy to see why. But not everyone thinks the feuds and nastiness of Washington is the way it should be. I'll always be a public servant and hold on to my motto: Low ego, no drama, mission first.

[**This is why I am running to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate. But I can't get there without your help. body:
As a single mom with three kids and a budget, I cook from scratch a lot.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=37123%2E3422442%2EsppEN8)
Derek,
As a single mom with three kids and a budget, I cook from scratch a lot.
But when I’m in Washington, I cannot cook dinner, and in my first year in Congress there was a lot of complaining—even about pizza! My kids want their mom’s cooking, and they want it nearly every night, regardless of where the demands of my job require me to be.
The solution is aggressive meal planning. On the days I fly to D.C. for votes and hearings, I get up at 5:30 a.m. I quickly get ready for the plane and then prepare a dinner for the kids to enjoy that night. It’s always a slow cooker recipe or something that can sit in the fridge until the kids cook it.
I’ve perfected a few quick, easy meal-prep recipes and I’d love to share them with you. [**Donate any amount using this link and we’ll send you some of my favorites including recipes for my grandma Doris’s meatballs, chili, and banana bread.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240130-1?refcode=em20240130-37123&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=37123_3422442_sppEN8&akid=37123%2E3422442%2EsppEN8)
_The recipes will be included in the receipt emailed to you by ActBlue after you make the donation._

You’re helping us tell voters that I’m the only candidate in this race who has never taken a dime from corporate PACs. And you’re showing Washington that people are ready for a Senator who will stand up to the status quo.
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240130-1?refcode=em20240130-37123&refcode2=37123_3422442_sppEN8&akid=37123%2E3422442%2EsppEN8)

Katie

Peter,
As January ends, COURIER is committed to defending our democracy from right-wing propaganda and misinformation by providing quality, rigorous journalism to the communities that need it most.
And unlike many mainstream media outlets, **_every single story_ is free to read online.** That's right, Peter — no paywalls, no subscription fees, and no right-wing spin. Just the reliable, high-quality reporting that our audiences have come to expect.
**With the first month of 2024 coming to a close, we took another look at our supporter records, and here's what we have on file for you:**
**2024 COURIER Supporter:** Peter **Supporter Status:** Not active yet! **Suggested contribution:** $5 **[Pitch in to power Democracy's Newsroom ➡️](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78047800/452241750/1411593997?refcode=em20240130&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzQ2NzY3MDctOTFiZi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uMJnJLuzUfSju7XJvBxd9yyCmmzTQXtArQlD2pMJkDI=)**

In 2023, our newsrooms provided critical get-out-the-vote information and news to communities across Wisconsin and Virginia. In those elections, voters delivered big wins for progressive causes and candidates, including the right to have an abortion.
We wouldn’t have had the resources to play an important role in these elections without your help. In 2024, our job is even tougher – **this time, we’re hiring journalists and running newsrooms in 10 battleground states,** the most we’ve ever had up and running in an election year.

## Welcome to the MIGOP Newsletter!
Each Monday, the Michigan Republican Party sends important information about what is happening within the party, state, and nation and how you can get involved.
---
|
---
| | | Hello:

As if we needed further proof that the Left is interfering in the 2024 election, last week, a New York jury [ordered](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=39ad33e46c&e=a2af77507c) President Donald Trump to pay $83.3 million to E. Jean Carroll in a civil defamation case. This is an [outrage](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=d806842bfd&e=a2af77507c) for many reasons, not least of which is the blatant injustice to a true patriot—and innocent man—and to real victims of sexual assault.

The ongoing [lawfare](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=9dfdc48ab7&e=a2af77507c) to destroy the reputation, person, and candidacy of President Trump demonstrates what we are up against, and why we must win resoundingly this year, not only for the presidency, but also at all levels of local, state, and federal government. _**Local elections are the most important guardians to our freedom.**_ Our model is to strengthen counties with the Good Neighbor Program. In the past, we have lacked a sufficient ground game.

We are also partnering with Turning Point Action to implement a robust ballot chasing program. Remember, ballot harvesting is illegal in Michigan. Though I am no fan of mail-in voting except for the elderly, handicapped, military, and individuals who cannot vote in person, we must win at ballot chasing especially for low propensity voters. Many people, unfortunately, lack the political will to ensure they vote in person, so we must ensure those individuals cast their ballots for all Republican candidates. If we don’t, those low propensity voters will vote Democrat and we can’t have that.

Much is at stake.

Please [join](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=dc297f6edf&e=a2af77507c) me and the real Michigan Republican Party as we fight for systemic election reform in Michigan and, through our [Good Neighbor Program](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=809898c317&e=a2af77507c), find, recruit, and elect America First candidates to office.

In Liberty,
Kristina Karamo
Chairwoman
Michigan Republican Party

body:
Peter,

My name is Don Samuels, and I’m running for Congress in Minnesota's Fifth District to defeat Rep. Ilhan Omar and provide our community the representation and leadership it deserves.
Just two years ago, my campaign came within 2,500 votes of unseating Rep. Ilhan Omar. The support we received was inspiring, and it showed just how hungry this community is for an alternative to the anger, division, and controversy stoked by my opponent.

Now, as we approach 2024, the stakes have never been higher. While my opponent and I share similar views on many policy issues, I believe this moment calls for an approach to leadership that Rep. Ilhan Omar has to this point refused–one that seeks to build a diverse coalition of supporters, united in our mission to create opportunity and progress for everyone.

But I can’t do this alone. Will you join our coalition by making a contribution today? We need your support to ensure we have the resources necessary to engage our community before the precinct caucuses at the end of February.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dsjan2024?refcode=gra

At a time when leadership is needed both at home and abroad, Rep. Ilhan Omar has shown time and again that she is more interested in boosting her profile than addressing the issues impacting our community. From undermining the Biden Administration by voting against long-overdue infrastructure funding, to voting against aid for Ukraine as they defend themselves from Russian aggression, Rep. Ilhan Omar has shown that she is more interested in advancing herself than the interests of our country.

The time has come to end this era of divisive politics. This is going to require hard work, collaboration, and an honest approach. Don Samuels
Candidate for U.S. Congress

Fellow Conservative,

**As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle.** Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate from Montana. You probably don't know me, or if you do, likely from emails like this one. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority.

**[I'm reaching out today to make the case that I'm worth your personal endorsement](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=410fda6b15f94f2d87915dceff4efa3e&_e=qd4Nd_ut9i2hs3OYLIcVd4TIVMHaF9NsfmGVHSpPqW-MM0ISdQWKAjGIfTDLHXIiUcfIoQf8n2qBI3Wwjz96wFcifuVK7kSg8w3CjtXG3482eLIK24PPTcqtRlhbw0XpmjfwG8avHmx0AzvEgzw7d3W8GiTESYsUUtP13kA5tbJWaFKPSSAXcPaIMPMWRNFxvmG-gsIevRNZF3DD5-bGT7kp_W0DQexsj8pJuIB8i_XEzGxGq_JDlwRa4QBkmA__vM4sNWhFylIxor_coLhZTNwWmi_8JMibxHxyYJDYTB9Sywlv83aG-w-TUQpZCDU8EAyg0WKqE1O9GGHnQ-DI5KE7t3dYYy30USnn1B72CN7CqCPXgGbSDsOqgAHWOzPMqJt1Cy9VGN6wpQZSWmgpx-PXm5kfwaysW0JJnGcqu1A%3D)**.

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [**many veterans like me**] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. January 30, 2024

MEDIA CONTACT
Robert Vane
robert@veteranstrategies.com
Lieutenant Governor Suzanne Crouch Files to run for Governor of Indiana
If elected Crouch will “Axe the Tax”, stand tough against China, deploy the Indiana National Guard to protect our southern border, fight the stigma against mental health and addiction, and protect our most vulnerable Hoosiers.
(INDIANAPOLIS, IN)— Today, Lt. Governor Suzanne Crouch filed the official paperwork to run for governor in 2024, turning in more than 8,000 verified signatures.

Earlier this month, the campaign also reported more than $3.77 million cash on hand, and it had collected more than 9,000 signatures to get on the ballot.

Since launching her campaign in December 2022, Crouch has pledged to eliminate Indiana’s individual income tax (https://crouchforindiana.com/axe-the-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d98a074e75-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_04_03_16_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c484a2aa29-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) and return thousands of dollars annually to taxpayers.

Crouch also pledged to keep China from buying up our farmland (https://vimeo.com/899679899/fffe98b3c2?share=copy&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f3a393a89f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_12_06_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-65daf18f47-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=d98a074e75-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_04_03_16_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c484a2aa29-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) and poisoning Hoosiers with illegal drugs like fentanyl.

“We haven’t come this far just to come this far,” said Crouch. “I am so grateful for all the volunteers and supporters who have made this moment possible. I will continue to travel the state and work to earn the votes of Hoosiers.”

Eighth District United States Congressman Larry Bucshon was one of the first Hoosier statesmen to support Crouch’s historic bid.

"Her track record of conservatism, demonstrated through her tenure in both the state of Indiana legislative and executive branches, inspires confidence in her ability to shape Indiana's future,” said Representative Bucshon. “There is no one better suited to represent the values of our Hoosier community and provide leadership for the state."

Additionally, more than one hundred past and present grassroots elected official—including twenty county sheriffs—have endorsed Crouch’s bid to be Indiana’s first female governor.
###
To learn more about how Suzanne is the only conservative Republican fighting China, proposing an elimination of Indiana’s individual income tax, and casting the key votes to protect our most vulnerable Hoosiers, please visit her web site at www.crouchforindiana.com.

_**Matt Dolan Receives Praise, Wins First GOP Debate.**_
* Following his victory in the first Republican Primary Debate, [Matt Dolan received widespread praise](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2d55d638693a4e6ca63ab40bbb70f387&_e=Y7ih3ualboO2OekupyZOmjffjpkVrx_ZRywHcF_xgpGsuHl1PglX7tBeaWKI0wKQACpKVUsaZsh34AfiOg-J3FAReAIFRyOaqfg6d3Zk8SqA1sAQ3_SP64wUtqVwotGCWfOEI2xITlnivVsxC5nwk9lhahWkwGrTw6vyBeyCa4aEXJ7FxlfSlN8IFohaMComWxyAyUAZU-5KnqUzoyqQPo7BKMvLCB6Qce8fYtVsU8ek8RMYolL4FXvXSVMxTF9f) for distinguishing himself as the proven, consistent conservative who can defeat Sherrod Brown in November.

* “Dolan, who was the night’s chief aggressor on stage, also asserted that, given his recent legislative experience, he is the most in sync with Trump while accusing his rivals of ‘phony’ reverence,” wrote Henry Gomez of NBC News.

* Matt Dolan also highlighted his opponents’ record of inconsistent positions on important issues based on which way the political winds were blowing, such as on immigration, support for Israel and previous business lawsuits.

** _Matt Dolan Earns Endorsement from Ohio Student Advocacy Group During School Choice Week._**
* Matt Dolan delivered universal school choice for Ohio families, putting parents, not bureaucrats, in charge of their children’s education.

* In recognition of last week being “Ohio School Choice Week,” Dolan said, “I'm proud of my work to make good on the promise of delivering universal school choice for Ohio families. We are empowering parents and creating new opportunities for kids throughout our state. In the Senate, I'll work to do the same for families across America.”

* Dolan also [earned the endorsement of “Youth Prosperity Ohio](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=2d55d638693a4e6ca63ab40bbb70f387&_e=Y7ih3ualboO2OekupyZOmjffjpkVrx_ZRywHcF_xgpFz1lvqvSv-8v1gyXEkvXgKNLOtyYeKMCBsgtfsvs1YSh7vP9jw6eEn0x_rHWvmV1fOSAEIupgM2s8BhhQ3G8H7VzJrzoKewU9NC6h0PANh-p66-54-kkMf2gRHxGDNAnlR8UvGAUc1EpEA_Jr8oFEhLg4x1Bs4S-1a8qiK8LoZKNUMGmOVBI8qK0J37YzYxfFz00BLHrkJYQVkwEnWv9KrcMFLBR4RYmwEZFSj7XP5_A%3D%3D),” an organization dedicated to ensuring that the children of Ohio prosper in their education journey. The group touted Dolan as a “true fighter for Ohio’s students.”

Dear Friend, In an alarming turn of events, Don Blankenship, infamously known as the **"King of Coal," joined me in the race for West Virginia's open U.S. Senate seat** —a position of power he seeks to exploit, disregarding the safety of workers and the sanctity of our environment for personal and corporate gain.

Blankenship led Massey Energy, which became synonymous with the most egregious safety violations in the mining industry, culminating in the devastating Upper Big Branch Mine disaster that **claimed 29 innocent lives**. His approach to business prioritized profit margins over the most basic safety standards, exposing workers to hazardous conditions day in and day out. In 2015, Blankenship was sentenced to one year in prison for conspiring to willfully violate mine safety and health standards in relation to the Upper Big Branch Mine explosion. I stand before you as a stark contrast to Blankenship's dark legacy. http://wsrp.org

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

**The Weird Money Connection Between This Dem and the Catholic Church’s Sex Abuse Scandal**

_She’s running to replace Katie Porter in Congress, touting social justice issues. But is she funding her campaign with money tainted by the Catholic Church sex abuse scandal?_

**By Roger Sollenberger**
Democratic House candidate Joanna Weiss has credited her legal experience for imbuing her with a “deep commitment to ethics.” The source of her personal campaign loans, however, is rife with controversy.

Weiss, a Democratic newcomer vying to replace Rep. Katie Porter (D-CA) as she runs for Senate, has contributed a total $231,600 to her political operation as of the end of September, according to publicly available campaign filings. Of that amount, $225,000 has come in the form of loans from the “personal funds of the candidate,” the filings show.

But Weiss’ personal financial disclosure, submitted in August, reports hardly any income over the prior 18 months, only listing $2,500 in royalties from an independent music publishing company she launched in 2021. She also doesn’t list any personal bank accounts, either. All of her accounts are jointly held with her husband, with the exception of her publishing company—and corporate funds are off-limits for campaign contributions.

Weiss also doesn’t appear to have been a big earner previously, though that seems to be by choice. According to online biographies and her LinkedIn page, Weiss eschewed the high-dollar corporate track in favor of pursuing an accomplished service-oriented career: teaching, followed by pro bono work, before leaving her personal practice to launch a mid-sized nonprofit-hybrid PAC combo devoted to community and political organizing. Tax returns for the nonprofit—“Women for American Values and Ethics (WAVE)”—show that Weiss has never drawn a salary, and campaign finance records don’t show a PAC salary, either, though the committee did contribute $9,000 to her campaign in March.

**That history suggests that, while Weiss has independently carved out a successful and impactful legal and advocacy career, the lion’s share of the money she’s used to fund her campaign may come from her husband, Jason Weiss, who has walked a far more lucrative—and controversial—career path.**

Specifically, Jason Weiss—a specialist in labor and employment law at Los Angeles-based Sheppard Mullin LLP—has defended the Catholic Diocese of Orange County in at least four sex abuse lawsuits.

That hasn’t stopped Joanna Weiss from burnishing her legal ethics during the campaign, including in attacks against her political rival. Nor has she addressed her husband’s longtime client in the context of abortion rights.

Weiss also doesn’t appear to have been a big earner previously, though that seems to be by choice. According to online biographies and her LinkedIn page, Weiss eschewed the high-dollar corporate track in favor of pursuing an accomplished service-oriented career: teaching, followed by pro bono work, before leaving her personal practice to launch a mid-sized nonprofit-hybrid PAC combo devoted to community and political organizing. Tax returns for the nonprofit—“Women for American Values and Ethics (WAVE)”—show that Weiss has never drawn a salary, and campaign finance records don’t show a PAC salary, either, though the committee did contribute $9,000 to her campaign in March. That history suggests that, while Weiss has independently carved out a successful and impactful legal and advocacy career, the lion’s share of the money she’s used to fund her campaign may come from her husband, Jason Weiss, who has walked a far more lucrative—and controversial—career path. Specifically, Jason Weiss—a specialist in labor and employment law at Los Angeles-based Sheppard Mullin LLP—has defended the Catholic Diocese of Orange County in at least four sex abuse lawsuits. That hasn’t stopped Joanna Weiss from burnishing her legal ethics during the campaign, including in attacks against her political rival. Fellow Conservative,

**As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle.** Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate from Montana. You probably don't know me, or if you do, likely from emails like this one. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority.

**[I'm reaching out today to make the case that I'm worth your personal endorsement](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=d3519f4f7f07421ca5261fac3461369c&_e=JYCssjPePFXzlc1OMZ8hpa6XYHa8rBTwMnvFL5nGi66wyg4YrIeU5PlkS65q2urMndZXvicqkfSMJ5VtWICBprsAXCDMthV-V1NOqEtgi4KedGMhSImwkxMpjRUduQEY5eYpFOXzqHpwLMNHhaTupLmjad56Whb1EYxJ_rZfuDTdXBrTNtYDskpE6Ga9uR6jGi_8MFKJsjbtgswjwnO3S3IX6qvhT6uUNCghjdV7P6QSw574-vReDwwyj27ymySN82klVwOJiNtsz9RuHFPbGXRGyFJCq6BS6VIbGYKkGzYjdT-B4_sB-R1Z6p0qDiIdmnVFR7YuiQik-NyJoxrtu9IDpcyLrs9Ns5mYHaGoxvKJxG5H_KkdnDL4-BAYH8w_TR2t5YuHZvscEtHg-GOXj5iAt27Aj2q7dhls-C9qFwQ%3D)**.

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [**many veterans like me**] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. _**Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.**_ I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

**[Today, I’m reaching out to ask you to personally endorse my campaign to become the next U.S. Senator from Montana.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=d3519f4f7f07421ca5261fac3461369c&_e=JYCssjPePFXzlc1OMZ8hpa6XYHa8rBTwMnvFL5nGi66wyg4YrIeU5PlkS65q2urMndZXvicqkfSMJ5VtWICBprsAXCDMthV-V1NOqEtgi4KedGMhSImwkxMpjRUduQEY5eYpFOXzqHpwLMNHhaTupLmjad56Whb1EYxJ_rZfuDTdXBrTNtYDskpE6Ga9uR6jGi_8MFKJsjbtgswjwnO3S3IX6qvhT6uUNCghjdV7P6QSw574-vReDwwyj27ymySN8UzufFSaQECFPi3Vpg3CtjNcr9LVu2pq-DmKRFNOWmmS_-I5LholsdkyYkaWs9q5mqHo2BhI61Z8AK9KrVLkXzf9gbU2fkwIm5iP2zvcPZaggANBLLU9WYHk4K2rQwsu2ErOglXPyWu-S49I3negxMwO9zc0ZBxbSnELiYO3_0s%3D)**

_**Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. **_

Fellow Conservative, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign the first time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that **anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it.**

**I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read.**

In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy.
