subject: Renew your LCV Membership Peter -- it's just $5 (Deadline TOMORROW)
body:
For a limited time, your support goes three times as far.

MEMBERSHIP DRIVE 2024
TRIPLE MATCH ACTIVE

Peter - we're following up as part of our annual Membership Drive.

Your membership matters. https://links.messages.lcv. LCV's annual Membership Drive determines the resources we have, and how hard we can fight for our environment and democracy, throughout the year. That's why it's so important that we hear from you.

Your support is critical right now. House Republicans led by "MAGA Mike" Johnson are conspiring to shut down important parts of the federal government in order to force through new oil and gas drilling on public lands, among other attacks on our environment and communities. Their proposals would gut clean energy investments and end almost all attempts to address environmental injustice. They would slash EPA's enforcement and public health protections, which would lead to dirtier air and water.

Our movement is what's stopping polluters and fossil fuel companies from getting their way - but we need more resources to keep our campaigns going in this critical election year.

The best thing you can do right now is to help fund our hard-hitting environmental campaigns. Renew your LCV membership today. For a limited time, every contribution will be TRIPLE MATCHED. Even $5 can make a difference >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/x_

---
League of Conservation Voters
2024 Membership Drive

Supporter Record: Peter Willis
Match Status: TRIPLE MATCH ACTIVE https://links.messages.lcv.

Deadline: 11:59 pm, January 31, 2024
Fundraising Goal: $50,000

Member Status: Renew your membership now for just $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.
---

Right now, we're fighting on multiple fronts for healthier communities and a better future for our planet. We can't afford to lose ANY of these fights. Here are just a few reasons to support LCV's work for the environment this year:
- Because MAGA Republicans are pushing even harder to slash clean energy investments, zero out funding for environmental justice, cut clean air and water enforcement, and mandate more dirty drilling leases. LCV is organizing quickly to mobilize grassroots pressure on Congress to reject reckless anti-environment proposals. But at the end of the day, the impact we can have will depend on our members. https://links.messages.lcv.
- Because anti-environment legislators are trying to stop important protections for the Arctic. Republicans' extreme legislation would put the Arctic at risk of more oil and gas drilling and threaten species like caribou. The environmental movement CANNOT sit this fight out. We need you, Peter. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/mkyVH2A7-RF~
- Because LCV is campaigning hard for the Biden administration to propose new protections that reduce pollution and promote healthy communities. We have a real chance to pressure the White House to go big for the sake of our climate and our health. Your support makes that happen. Renew your membership today >> https://links.messages.lcv.
- Because a group of donors is triple-matching every contribution this month. Bottom line, your contribution goes further to win environmental progress if you give now. Triple your impact now >> https://links.messages.lcv.

It's important that we hear from you, Peter. Please, renew your LCV membership for just $5 today while it will be triple matched >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/qjPNc8RWL0t_

Onward,

LCV Membership Team

body:
Will you let me tell you a bit about my family and how they've inspired me to run for Senate?
| | |
---
Friend, my family has been built on the backs of generations of strong women. Will you let me tell you a bit about my family and how they've inspired me to run for the Senate?
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78078093/452312732/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk717-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzAxZWJlZTktYmFiZi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Enw3ov7EU6x5miOsoM8chf-Dt-ofyZORWlhXyEdhXec=)
My mother worked full-time to raise my older sisters and me. That was pretty uncommon in Ecuador back then. With my mom so busy (and never much of a cook anyways), my grandmother was the one who would come over and prepare meals for us. She was an amazing cook, and she was an even stronger woman.
I remember watching her cook some of the best meals I’ve ever had — and always being there when my sisters and I needed her. Her strength and her resilience have been passed down, from generation to generation.
When I was 14, my mother made the difficult but incredibly brave decision to bring my sisters and me to America. She worked so hard in those early days. I remember her taking on double shifts at work and somehow still fitting in English classes at night. All of us kids stepped up to help make ends meet and build a home in our new country. My older sisters were always there for me, too. When school got hard, when bullies made fun of my accent, or when teachers underestimated me because of my background, they always stood up for me — and taught me to stand up for myself.
**My grandmother, my mother, and my sisters taught me to work hard and never, ever give up.** Their sacrifices and courage are the reason why I was able to go to college, start a career giving back to my community, and eventually become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress.
They are the reason I was able to achieve my American Dream. **And now, I'm raising my daughters to live the same way — to follow their dreams and always stand up for themselves. But these days, the American Dream is out of reach for more and more families.** It's harder to get a good-paying job or afford a home. And our fundamental rights — to vote, to access health care, and so much more — are increasingly under attack.
That's why I'm running for Senate: **To give every family, here in Florida and across the country, the opportunities that mine had._And to help make it a bit easier for the next generation to achieve their American Dream._**
Look, polling data shows that my race is a statistical tie. But more than the numbers, I feel it in my bones that Florida is ready to flip blue. Families here are ready for a Senator who will listen to them and deliver results, not pull our communities apart. **[_So please, if you believe in a future where we all can achieve our American Dream, will you donate $5 or whatever you can spare to help me flip Florida blue and fight for your family in the Senate? In a race like this, every donation makes a difference._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78078096/452312735/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk717-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzAxZWJlZTktYmFiZi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Enw3ov7EU6x5miOsoM8chf-Dt-ofyZORWlhXyEdhXec=)**

Our government should never tell working families "you're on your own." / I need your support to keep fighting for solutions for working families.
| | |
---
Peter,

When I was a teenager, my dad – a World War II veteran and Purple Heart recipient – was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis.
It got to a point where he could no longer work. Our family had some help from the VA, but my mom had to step up to keep a roof over all of our heads and cover his rising medical costs. **Luckily, back then, the government didn't just say "_you're on your own._ "** Veterans benefits, food stamps, federal student loans, and a federal work study were there for us – allowing for my mom to return to school to get a better paying job, and for me and my six siblings to all go to college and get a higher education.
This experience is part of the reason why I fight every day for progressive policies that support working families in Washington state and across the U.S. I've seen firsthand the difference they can make, **but to keep up the fight, I need your help.**
National Republicans are desperate to retake Senate control this year. **In a race experts are calling the "Senate map from hell," we have to invest in defending and expanding our blue majority to keep it –** _and policies that put working families first_** – intact.**

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=37132%2E3422442%2EcD6izb)
Derek,
In 2022, amidst rising inflation, I’m sure you’ll remember there was a lot of finger pointing. Was it supply chains, interrupted by war and the pandemic? Greedy corporations? Washington’s failure to act?
All three played a role. And I was deeply disappointed that the Senate never even bothered to vote on my bill that would have made price-gouging by oil companies illegal. But in fall of 2022, armed with lots of data, I used a Congressional Hearing to get answers from an economist who confirmed what I saw the numbers pointing to: **record, rising corporate profits were accounting for at least half of the higher prices consumers were paying.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240130-2?refcode=em20240130-37132&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=37132_3422442_cD6izb&akid=37132%2E3422442%2EcD6izb)
Big corporations _still_ are trying to play the victim here—saying they’re just passing on higher costs to customers. But oftentimes, that’s BS. From July through September 2023, the most recent period we have data for, corporate profits were just shy of the record peak they reached in 2022. **Collectively, big corporations are making more than a *trillion* dollars more every three months than they were in 2017.**
It’s on Congress to rein in these corporations. Too many billionaires are getting richer while more and more families can’t afford rent. And that’s exactly why I’m running for the U.S. Senate.
**I’m the only Democrat in this race who has never taken a dime from corporate PACs, but now I’m being outspent by my opponent who has taken these checks for decades. I need your support if we’re going to compete.[Our January end-of-month deadline is Wednesday at midnight. Is there anything you can give today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240130-2?refcode=em20240130-37132&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=37132_3422442_cD6izb&akid=37132%2E3422442%2EcD6izb)**

Thanks in advance. I can’t do this without you!
Katie

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=em20240130-37132&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=37132_3422442_cD6izb&akid=37132%2E3422442%2EcD6izb)**

subject: We can do even more.

body:
#
On the Meet The Press this weekend, Kristen Welker asked Alexandria if she thought Democrats are doing a good enough job explaining to voters why they should vote for President Biden, and not just _against_ Donald Trump.
**Here’s what she had to say:**
_I think we can certainly do more to be advancing our vision, and I believe that we have a strong vision that we can run on.
For what it’s worth, the President has said, ‘If you give me the House, and if you give me the Senate and reelect me to the presidency, we will codify abortion rights and the right to choose in this country. We’ll codify reproductive rights.’
**I think we can do more.**
I think we need to be talking more about healthcare. Of course, me as a progressive, I want to see the age of Medicare drop — whether it’s to 50, as the president has discussed earlier, or to zero, as is my preference, to **extend Medicare to all people in the United States of America.**
We can talk even more about the fact that **public colleges and universities should be tuition free or reduced**. The president has advanced student loan forgiveness just this month for people who have taken out SAVE loans under $12,000. They will see their loans wiped out.
But I do believe that advancing that affirmative vision is going to be very, very important as well as really laying out and showing, between now and November, through our governing decisions, when we have that power in the White House, what we are willing to do with it._
[This is why Alexandria came to Congress: to fight for working families like hers, and hold her Party accountable along the way. Will you make a $5 contribution today to show you support pushing the Democratic Party forward?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240130.QXMCJU&refcode=em20240130-5726-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5726%2E2526796%2E6ZNc86)

We need to show widespread support for Alexandria so she can continue doing what she was elected to do: **demand better.**
Every dollar, no matter the amount, shows widespread support for our progressive priorities from NY-14 and beyond.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

Fellow Conservative,

**As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle.** Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate from Montana. You probably don't know me, or if you do, likely from emails like this one. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority.

**[I'm reaching out today to make the case that I'm worth your personal endorsement](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=36cebd0df0514dc09769bf07fe9e2238&_e=hF9o1jpQ6kKPrZWXpI4Z3JCKObmTDxcnZK26eGxT7rb1ahkyz_BdWWZ1Zk3UlDHrSYfZcII7k1KHkuchDUG9URMEqTu9wVg-iNKNqfbIC1Myx81D37sD39SPTqTM_FaITqftEEP8a9TaUEutpGWUjBbyBMRdj-WWg0vgPW9_p7jdi_bmpK8UPrGiWYYh5pN9hS2B2xLWSz9gcBjqPGp8h4ghXzeUkYcAWx9XYEtIM09h0GPFNgxVnHszgSsxHg87y-KM357oV0v9BsDuoYFm3XoNd8PPZAuDo76U5TfLs85G-5Xe6t8idImeMFCSFXII3nPP9LXWz5OtsdNDCuayofKzyT7ZBnIcDUnwyA_w2Bh29avrNyay2mI6dxUBVcdTnokAn1EXRyGIFynSo6e6RzHs5RKP3zykXdVSM-F_t3U%3D)**.

[](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=36cebd0df0514dc09769bf07fe9e2238&_e=hF9o1jpQ6kKPrZWXpI4Z3JCKObmTDxcnZK26eGxT7rb1ahkyz_BdWWZ1Zk3UlDHrSYfZcII7k1KHkuchDUG9URMEqTu9wVg-iNKNqfbIC1Myx81D37sD39SPTqTM_FaITqftEEP8a9TaUEutpGWUjBbyBMRdj-WWg0vgPW9_p7jdi_bmpK8UPrGiWYYh5pN9hS2B2xLWSz9gcBjqPGp8h4ghXzeUkYcAWx9XYEtIM09h0GPFNgxVnHszgSsxHg87SYMAucVlo7XCnj8DFoS-eSehtZhq47GNd8Stze_zNGoWQdKDSt0d7RztbyhzEnMR_j-H6Vpmt0RUNSVySlyE984Nn9XJBUrrPgtkO6c_4dO2_bdsOr3SDbYWlPiQ_ePOVKtCJkpUtP9V5naqXEpHDu39sC69-9Ci11flgBMYtQU%3D)
In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [**many veterans like me**] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. _**Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.**_ I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

**[Today, I’m reaching out to ask you to personally endorse my campaign to become the next U.S. Senator from Montana.](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=36cebd0df0514dc09769bf07fe9e2238&_e=hF9o1jpQ6kKPrZWXpI4Z3JCKObmTDxcnZK26eGxT7rb1ahkyz_BdWWZ1Zk3UlDHrSYfZcII7k1KHkuchDUG9URMEqTu9wVg-iNKNqfbIC1Myx81D37sD39SPTqTM_FaITqftEEP8a9TaUEutpGWUjBbyBMRdj-WWg0vgPW9_p7jdi_bmpK8UPrGiWYYh5pN9hS2B2xLWSz9gcBjqPGp8h4ghXzeUkYcAWx9XYEtIM09h0GPFNgxVnHszgSsxHg87EQIfaUJbV-KuCobiwhAPf8l7JjUoA0FCHfUeqxbmGn0EEfuKhdgsMhxUPPxFLJIS2FPRVzPCKPhoLuT_-AI6q_Uap0LfIW4SixnfwgxYB0HB2RdcrfNRSHiBdAcuFW5GQr3quKrG0pVIgN6rVFwQg2_Ua3R6PvazedbIOJTRK70%3D)**

_**Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. **_

Fellow Conservative, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign the first time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that **anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it.**

**I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read.**

In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis.

[](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=36cebd0df0514dc09769bf07fe9e2238&_e=hF9o1jpQ6kKPrZWXpI4Z3JCKObmTDxcnZK26eGxT7rb1ahkyz_BdWWZ1Zk3UlDHrSYfZcII7k1KHkuchDUG9URMEqTu9wVg-iNKNqfbIC1Myx81D37sD39SPTqTM_FaITqftEEP8a9TaUEutpGWUjBbyBMRdj-WWg0vgPW9_p7jdi_bmpK8UPrGiWYYh5pN9hS2B2xLWSz9gcBjqPGp8h4ghXzeUkYcAWx9XYEtIM09h0GPFNgxVnHszgSsxHg87sbO1D4aQ6c2UZops4OLmgTzzbXZcpBWSf0JRL5BaOMkbjBl32ZWUM21hpLYvVtaL7wuMcq3bzdy-Ue9fFCBGwnj9HaBSTar1sRqf9f-d_CAloZgptyc8uHY1xNaTuKMUfbUaEhmE5pLnrH2Fk5tqUcj35QOGwJZRR-4VDbTdbzg%3D)
[**ENDORSE FMR. SEAL TIM SHEEHY TODAY** ](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=36cebd0df0514dc09769bf07fe9e2238&_e=hF9o1jpQ6kKPrZWXpI4Z3JCKObmTDxcnZK26eGxT7rb1ahkyz_BdWWZ1Zk3UlDHrSYfZcII7k1KHkuchDUG9URMEqTu9wVg-iNKNqfbIC1Myx81D37sD39SPTqTM_FaITqftEEP8a9TaUEutpGWUjBbyBMRdj-WWg0vgPW9_p7jdi_bmpK8UPrGiWYYh5pN9hS2B2xLWSz9gcBjqPGp8h4ghXzeUkYcAWx9XYEtIM09h0GPFNgxVnHszgSsxHg87nPVN0xZpT4WwttIHflfnMEamGo-ljfsywBhEvqiM9ZMHAvWlNGFG7PsE2DsplulnScxW5vteLcg2G1VvL2GxEV95oMVx-1bKPUxYnJv02Rx9FOukEx7p1GOICS0kXUK3XD25u6t51ueqIZf8iylOyzABq31LwJPaO7pSqJUQAEE%3D)

Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. **When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you.**

I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. _And believe me, there are some tales._

**I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism.** I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why [**I am determined to take on the anti-American, radical Left in Washington as Montana’s next U.S. Senator.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=36cebd0df0514dc09769bf07fe9e2238&_e=hF9o1jpQ6kKPrZWXpI4Z3JCKObmTDxcnZK26eGxT7rb1ahkyz_BdWWZ1Zk3UlDHrSYfZcII7k1KHkuchDUG9URMEqTu9wVg-iNKNqfbIC1Myx81D37sD39SPTqTM_FaITqftEEP8a9TaUEutpGWUjBbyBMRdj-WWg0vgPW9_p7jdi_bmpK8UPrGiWYYh5pN9hS2B2xLWSz9gcBjqPGp8h4ghXzeUkYcAWx9XYEtIM09h0GPFNgxVnHszgSsxHg87KnEORctN4u2p9B2WjQIr4Cx-J_m54TZwQM3Z4orsEsMjLg9JkDSCsuu1VNiybnz8dqaG5cCVsGfWcPB2VNxpmJbMrzmVfgn4N0OaFrs5iwImnLIDXW5O5vxn0H0rghc5_Ri9c0ZackU0KHFIWFB5QYHQYfJS6xptusmbT6Ifw2M%3D)

[**ENDORSE FMR. SEAL TIM SHEEHY TODAY** ](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=36cebd0df0514dc09769bf07fe9e2238&_e=hF9o1jpQ6kKPrZWXpI4Z3JCKObmTDxcnZK26eGxT7rb1ahkyz_BdWWZ1Zk3UlDHrSYfZcII7k1KHkuchDUG9URMEqTu9wVg-iNKNqfbIC1Myx81D37sD39SPTqTM_FaITqftEEP8a9TaUEutpGWUjBbyBMRdj-WWg0vgPW9_p7jdi_bmpK8UPrGiWYYh5pN9hS2B2xLWSz9gcBjqPGp8h4ghXzeUkYcAWx9XYEtIM09h0GPFNgxVnHszgSsxHg87yD-G_HZrfgOfxHylA4X52mqH84HnhEirGI2mz9l41QZrgCt_CQmmP4p0Ebhp9SJdsAwlHZ_Hb1F4ndtwfAcTOPmQPt6Lhm6jsAqhZiN77oRxTcgBOE5S5nuYiWz_izMTPO5j3H0V5noqLoo1xiD9ZwnVexg1aZvWJ209TIkO9lw%3D)

Our homeland is in danger. Radical Democrats in Washington want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. This FAR-LEFT liberal agenda is assaulting our society, communities, and the American Dream.

**The Democrats’ grip on power is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security.**

body:
Mel Feuer served in World War II as a ball turret gunner on a B-24 bomber. In April 1944, his plane was shot down over France. He was captured by the Nazis and spent a year in the infamous Stalag 17 prison camp.

Mike Feuer for Congress | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78081941/452325063/1971937322?amount=25&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2024.01.30_B1_Dad_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MjAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzgzNzIyNDYtYzViZi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=gszSRu9zu510vBqISb48Y8fpOMnSr4CoIhnQQCSrICI=) **Friend, I want to tell you about the person who inspired me to enter public service: my dad.** Mel Feuer served in World War II as a ball turret gunner on a B-24 bomber. He had enlisted to fight the Nazis after learning about the ongoing horrors of the Holocaust in Europe. In April 1944, Nazis shot his plane down over France. He was captured and spent a year in the infamous Stalag 17 prison camp. In 1945, the Nazis forced Mel and his fellow Prisoners of War to march across Austria as they fled the advancing Russian army. With a badly injured foot, Mel dragged himself forward until American troops liberated him on May 3, 1945. Through this experience, my father decided to dedicate his life to serving others. He became a beloved schoolteacher, principal, and dedicated volunteer in public schools. **In a very real sense, my father showed me the way. He taught me how precious life is, and how fragile. And he taught me to pursue the most important work in the world, which for me is tackling our most significant public issues and protecting our most vulnerable neighbors.** Although my dad passed away in 2015 at the age of 92, I'll never forget the lessons he taught about responsibility, honesty, and looking out for others. Following the principles and values I learned from my dad, I found my calling as a public servant — as the leader of Bet Tzedek/The House of Justice, as an LA City Councilmember, CA State Assemblymember, and twice-elected LA City Attorney. Now, I’m seeking to continue his legacy as our community’s representative in Congress. Eighty years after my dad fought Nazis in Europe, we're facing forces perilously close to fascism here at home. It's more critical than ever to have leaders who stand up for our democracy, civil rights, LGBTQ+ rights, and women’s reproductive rights — and against dangerous efforts to divide our country and demonize our neighbors. **Throughout my career, I’ve stood up to big oil and tobacco companies, gun manufacturers, environmental polluters, predatory lenders, and big insurance. And I’ve stood up to Donald Trump and will continue to do so — to save our democracy — if I am fortunate enough to be elected to succeed Adam Schiff in Congress.** [_**I'm proud to share my father's story as part of this campaign — and with your support, we can reach even more CA-30 voters with our message that the urgency of this moment demands a proven national leader who will stand up for democracy and tackle homelessness, gun violence, the climate crisis and more with skill and integrity. clean_body: Mel Feuer served in World War II as a ball turret gunner on a B-24 bomber. In April 1944, his plane was shot down over France. He was captured by the Nazis and spent a year in the infamous Stalag 17 prison camp. Mike Feuer for Congress | = Friend, I want to tell you about the person who inspired me to enter public service: my dad. Mel Feuer served in World War II as a ball turret gunner on a B-24 bomber. He had enlisted to fight the Nazis after learning about the ongoing horrors of the Holocaust in Europe. In April 1944, Nazis shot his plane down over France. He was captured and spent a year in the infamous Stalag 17 prison camp. In 1945, the Nazis forced Mel and his fellow Prisoners of War to march across Austria as they fled the advancing Russian army. With a badly injured foot, Mel dragged himself forward until American troops liberated him on May 3, 1945. Through this experience, my father decided to dedicate his life to serving others. He became a beloved schoolteacher, principal, and dedicated volunteer in public schools. In a very real sense, my father showed me the way. He taught me how precious life is, and how fragile. And he taught me to pursue the most important work in the world, which for me is tackling our most significant public issues and protecting our most vulnerable neighbors. Although my dad passed away in 2015 at the age of 92, I'll never forget the lessons he taught about responsibility, honesty, and looking out for others. Following the principles and values I learned from my dad, I found my calling as a public servant — as the leader of Bet Tzedek/The House of Justice, as an LA City Councilmember, CA State Assemblymember, and twice-elected LA City Attorney. Now, I’m seeking to continue his legacy as our community’s representative in Congress. Eighty years after my dad fought Nazis in Europe, we're facing forces perilously close to fascism here at home. It's more critical than ever to have leaders who stand up for our democracy, civil rights, LGBTQ+ rights, and women’s reproductive rights — and against dangerous efforts to divide our country and demonize our neighbors. Throughout my career, I’ve stood up to big oil and tobacco companies, gun manufacturers, environmental polluters, predatory lenders, and big insurance. | Peter,

At the beginning of this month, I sent out a campaign survey to hear from people like you on which issues matter most to you and what you hope our campaign will prioritize.

We received an overwhelming number of responses from people everywhere, but one response that stood out was **concern for our democracy.**

In these last few weeks, it has become abundantly clear that Donald Trump is expected to be the Republican nominee for president this November.

As a Member of Congress and former CIA officer, I have taken an oath multiple times to protect and defend the Constitution, and I’ve seen how fragile democracy is, especially when extremists are undermining our institutions and sowing distrust. Like many Americans, I have been proud that our institutions held, not just during his four-year presidency but in the aftermath of the 2020 election and amid the efforts he led to undermine and overturn the results of that election. However, our institutions did not hold on their own. They held because of people supporting them and protecting them – people across the spectrum from Administration appointees to Members of Congress to local and state elected officials to our fellow Americans willing to speak the truth.

We need your support to elect Abigail Spanberger as Virginia’s next governor, but if you’d prefer not to receive emails from our campaign, you can at any time. = | Peter, At the beginning of this month, I sent out a campaign survey to hear from people like you on which issues matter most to you and what you hope our campaign will prioritize. We received an overwhelming number of responses from people everywhere, but one response that stood out was concern for our democracy. In these last few weeks, it has become abundantly clear that Donald Trump is expected to be the Republican nominee for president this November. As a Member of Congress and former CIA officer, I have taken an oath multiple times to protect and defend the Constitution, and I’ve seen how fragile democracy is, especially when extremists are undermining our institutions and sowing distrust. Like many Americans, I have been proud that our institutions held, not just during his four-year presidency but in the aftermath of the 2020 election and amid the efforts he led to undermine and overturn the results of that election. However, our institutions did not hold on their own. They held because of people supporting them and protecting them – people across the spectrum from Administration appointees to Members of Congress to local and state elected officials to our fellow Americans willing to speak the truth. Tomorrow I have a big decision to make and it’s going to have a big impact on our campaign. I’m going to explain why I need your support and if you can chip in to help us reach our goal, I’ll leave a link **[here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78083233/452329082/753479076?&refcode=E6178-20240130-BigDecision-SL-DeadlineEOM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjllMGU5NTEtYzliZi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HDKF1XJKtqgkIqwmE0iZlf72Wd6zevoPfTONE9DjrEs=)**.
The Republicans have ramped up their attacks on me like never before, and our election against my GOP opponent Kevin Lincoln is coming up on March 5th.
So, I need to decide how much we can spend on ads to make sure Democrats get out to vote. We have to make this critical investment because this is the first time I’ll be going head to head with my GOP opponent. We absolutely cannot lose this first big test.
But the question is: how many voters can we reach with the budget we have available for this upcoming election?
That depends on whether we reach our goal before the end-of-month deadline tomorrow. If we reach our goal, I’ll tell my team to launch these ads right away. If not, we may have to wait another week!
We have to raise $7k to make this initial investment, so I’m hoping you will please send in a donation today. # We increased the minimum wage!
Thousands of Delaware workers saw a pay increase – the next step in our state’s journey toward a $15 minimum wage – on January 1st.
I was proud to cosponsor and vote for Delaware's landmark $15 minimum wage law and will continue to fight for better pay and benefits and stronger protections for the right to unionize – because we know that when workers are strong, our economy thrives.
# I introduced the Student Loan Borrower Bill of Rights.
It has been so great to go back to Dover for the legislative session. I love my job – it’s so wonderful to wake up every day and go to work for the great people of Delaware.
**Recently, I introduced the Student Loan Borrower Bill of Rights.**
130,000 Delawareans carry student loan debt. For too long, students have had to navigate predatory behavior, confusing terms, and deceptive practices with ample support. This past month, the bill took its first step in the legislative process by passing committee.
And I’m excited to work with my colleagues on this legislation – and much more – over the next few weeks.
# We announced SEVERAL new endorsements from community leaders, elected officials, and organizations.
Our momentum continued on the campaign trail as well! We were proud to receive several new endorsements. In 2023, we announced the support of statewide leaders like Attorney General Kathy Jennings, legislative leaders, and major unions.
We started 2023 out with exciting support from local leaders like **New Castle Mayor Valarie Windle Leary** and community leaders like **Maria Matos**. I’m so honored to have their support in this campaign to deliver for Delaware.
**The Shore Democrats** have played a pivotal role in the blue wave crashing on the shores of Sussex County over the last few elections. I'm so excited to receive their first-ever endorsement in a primary and to have received it through a unanimous vote. Together, we will win in Sussex and across Delaware!
And I’m so proud to have the endorsement of **Elect Democratic Women** , the only Congressional member-led organization dedicated to electing more pro-choice Democratic women to Congress. When I’m elected, we’ll work together to protect reproductive freedoms and fight for policies that support all women and families.
